papers.title_zh: Effect of non-intubated spontaneous breathing video-assisted thoracoscopic surgery (NI-VATS) versus intubated general anesthesia (I-VATS) on the risk of postoperative venous thromboembolism.
papers.title_en: Effect of non-intubated spontaneous breathing video-assisted thoracoscopic surgery (NI-VATS) versus intubated general anesthesia (I-VATS) on the risk of postoperative venous thromboembolism.
papers.authors: Ye J, Chen D, Tang Z
papers.affiliation_highlight: Department of Cardiothoracic Surgery, Affiliated Jinhua Hospital, Zhejiang University School of Medicine (Jinhua Central…
papers.abstract_en: BACKGROUND: By preserving spontaneous breathing and avoiding mechanical ventilation, Non-intubated video-assisted thoracoscopic surgery may attenuate perioperative inflammatory responses and promote early mobilization, thereby influencing the risk of venous thromboembolism. However, whether the risk of postoperative venous thromboembolism differs between Non-intubated video-assisted thoracoscopic surgery and conventional Intubated video-assisted thoracoscopic surgery remains unclear due to a lack of definitive evidence. We hypothesized that patients undergoing Non-intubated video-assisted thoracoscopic surgery would have a lower risk of postoperative venous thromboembolism. METHODS: A single-center retrospective study was conducted. Patients with lung cancer who underwent video-assisted thoracoscopic lung surgery at the Department of Cardiothoracic Surgery, Jinhua Central Hospital between March 2025 and July 2025 were enrolled and, based on the anesthetic approach, divided into the Non-intubated video-assisted thoracoscopic surgery group (n = 25) and the Intubated video-assisted thoracoscopic surgery group (n = 30). The primary outcome was the risk of venous thromboembolism, as assessed by thrombotic complications, postoperative coagulation parameters, time to early postoperative ambulation, time to first flatus, and time to first defecation. RESULTS: No perioperative venous thromboembolic complications occurred in either group. Regarding coagulation parameters, the D-dimer level in the Non-intubated video-assisted thoracoscopic surgery group was 0.30 (0.04, 0.70) µg/L, which was significantly lower than 0.77 (0.34, 1.46) µg/L in the I-VATS group (P = 0.006). There were no statistically significant differences in prothrombin time (PT) or activated partial thromboplastin time (APTT) between the two groups (P > 0.05). The time to early postoperative ambulation was significantly shorter in the Non-intubated video-assisted thoracoscopic surgery group [0 (0, 0) days] than in the Intubated video-assisted thoracoscopic surgery group [1 (1, 1) days] (P < 0.001). The time to first flatus and defecation was 1 (1, 1) day in the Non-intubated video-assisted thoracoscopic surgery group, significantly shorter than 2 (2, 3) days in the Intubated video-assisted thoracoscopic surgery group (P < 0.001). Furthermore, the Non-intubated video-assisted thoracoscopic surgery group exhibited a significantly attenuated elevation in the inflammatory marker (leukocyte count: 2.24 ± 0.39 × 10⁹/L) compared with the Intubated video-assisted thoracoscopic surgery group (5.82 ± 0.60 × 10⁹/L). CONCLUSIONS: Non-intubated video-assisted thoracoscopic surgery may reduce the risk of venous thromboembolism through several mechanisms: maintaining negative intrathoracic pressure generated by spontaneous breathing, lowering the risk of elevated intra-abdominal pressure, and facilitating early mobilization - all of which enhance venous return; substituting general anesthesia with combined regional anesthesia; and avoiding muscle relaxants, thereby attenuating surgery-induced hypercoagulability and preserving endothelial function.

papers.title_zh: Construction of polyethylene glycol-cloaked mesoporous polydopamine nanomaterials co-loaded with anticancer drugs for photo/chemotherapy of lung cancer cells and elucidation of the cell death mechanism.
papers.title_en: Construction of polyethylene glycol-cloaked mesoporous polydopamine nanomaterials co-loaded with anticancer drugs for photo/chemotherapy of lung cancer cells and elucidation of the cell death mechanism.
papers.authors: Hu Y, Han X
papers.affiliation_highlight: Department of the Laboratory, Anting Hospital, Jiading District, Shanghai, 201805, China.
papers.abstract_en: Lung cancer is one of the leading causes of cancer-related deaths worldwide. The mortality rate can be reduced through the development of novel therapeutic drugs for lung cancer. In this study, we developed nanoparticles (NPs) consisting of polyethylene glycol (PEG)-cloaked mesoporous polydopamine (MP) loaded with indocyanine green (IG) and talazoparib (TZ), designed to combine therapies for lung cancer. MP NPs were synthesized and surface-capped with methoxypolyethylene glycol amine. PEG2K-MP and PEG5K-MP NPs were analyzed using dynamic light scattering, scanning electron microscopy, and transmission electron microscopy. PEG2K-MP@IG&TZ and PEG5K-MP@IG&TZ NPs were developed using the solvent diffusion technique to co-load IG and TZ. The reduction in drug-feeding ratios led to a decrease in the amount of drug loaded and an increase in the encapsulation efficiency. PEG2K-MP@IG&TZ and PEG5K-MP@IG&TZ NPs, which showed excellent drug loading efficiency (IG: 9.9 ± 0.4% and 9.1 ± 0.2%; TZ: 6.8 ± 0.3% and 6.5 ± 0.2%), were chosen for further investigation. The hydrodynamic sizes ranged from 200 to 300 nm. These nanoparticles exhibited improved stability of IG in water, near-infrared laser-stimulated release of TZ, effective photothermal activity, excellent biocompatibility, and increased cellular uptake. These two nanoparticles demonstrated a stronger anticancer effect on lung cancer A549 cells than the combination of IG and TZ when irradiated with 808 nm light in vitro. Fluorescence microscopy revealed that PEG5K-MP@IG&TZ NPs efficiently triggered apoptosis in A549 cells. This study presents an innovative and efficient method for combination therapy against lung cancer cells.

papers.title_zh: Identification and validation of NCOA5-ZCCHC3/FGF22 axis as a prognostic marker in lung adenocarcinoma migration and invasion.
papers.title_en: Identification and validation of NCOA5-ZCCHC3/FGF22 axis as a prognostic marker in lung adenocarcinoma migration and invasion.
papers.authors: Yu Y, Jin W, Chaogetu E, Zhang X, Liu X, Gao Y, Li F, Su R et al.
papers.affiliation_highlight: Graduate School of Inner Mongolia Medical University, Hohhot, China.
papers.abstract_en: Lung adenocarcinoma (LUAD), the most common subtype of lung cancer, is associated with substantial global mortality. Nuclear receptor coactivator 5 (NCOA5) has been implicated in several malignancies; however, its functional role and regulatory mechanisms in LUAD remain largely unknown. In this study, NCOA5 expression was evaluated in 94 paired LUAD and adjacent tissues using immunohistochemistry, RT-PCR, and Western blotting. Functional analyses were conducted using shRNA knockdown, CRISPR-mediated knockout, and overexpression models to assess the effects of NCOA5 on LUAD cell proliferation, migration, invasion, apoptosis, cell cycle progression, and organoid formation. Xenograft models were used to validate tumorigenicity in vivo. IP-MS and co-immunoprecipitation identified NCOA5-interacting proteins, while ChIP-seq and dual-luciferase assays interrogated downstream transcriptional regulation. NCOA5 was significantly upregulated in LUAD tissues and associated with advanced stage, poor differentiation, and reduced overall survival, serving as an independent prognostic factor (P < .040). NCOA5 knockdown inhibited LUAD cell proliferation, migration, invasion, induced G0/G1 arrest, promoted apoptosis, reduced organoid formation, and suppressed xenograft growth, whereas NCOA5 overexpression produced the opposite effects. Among 39 candidate interacting proteins identified by IP-MS, ZCCHC3 was validated as a direct NCOA5-binding partner. ZCCHC3 depletion phenocopied NCOA5 loss and reversed NCOA5-induced proliferation, migration, invasion, and colony formation, supporting a functional NCOA5-ZCCHC3 interaction. ChIP-seq analysis identified fibroblast growth factor 22 (FGF22) as a direct transcriptional target of NCOA5. FGF22 was markedly downregulated in LUAD tissues and higher FGF22 expression was associated with improved patient survival. NCOA5 suppressed FGF22 transcription, while NCOA5 inhibition increased FGF22 expression. Functionally, FGF22 knockdown enhanced LUAD aggressiveness, whereas FGF22 restoration abrogated the oncogenic effects of NCOA5 in vitro and in vivo. Collectively, these findings identify a previously unrecognized NCOA5-ZCCHC3/FGF22 axis that drives LUAD progression and provide new mechanistic insight into the role of NCOA5 in LUAD biology.

papers.title_zh: Type I IFN promotes ILC2-to-ILC1 plasticity in pre-clinical radiation-induced lung injury.
papers.title_en: Type I IFN promotes ILC2-to-ILC1 plasticity in pre-clinical radiation-induced lung injury.
papers.authors: Kim J, Li H, Mannan R, Doherty TA, McGee HM
papers.affiliation_highlight: Department of Radiation Oncology, City of Hope, Duarte, CA, USA.
papers.abstract_en: Radiation-induced lung injury (RILI) is a common dose-limiting toxicity after radiotherapy for lung cancer, but the immunological mechanisms contributing to RILI pathogenesis remain poorly understood. Here we analyze a RILI mouse model using high-dose, restricted-field irradiation to the left lung. Flow cytometry and cytokine profiling analysis of innate lymphoid cells (ILC) reveals a radiation-induced shift from lung-resident type 2 ILCs (ILC2) toward pro-inflammatory type 1 ILCs (ILC1). Single-cell RNA-sequencing analysis of mouse lung ILC populations after radiation suggests that type I interferon (IFN) promotes radiation-induced ILC2-to-ILC1 plasticity. In vitro, IFN-β stimulation of mouse ILC2s leads to increased expression of the ILC1 markers T-bet and IFN-γ, while IFN-β stimulation of human peripheral blood mononuclear cells increases the ILC1-to-ILC2 ratio. In vivo, inhibition of type I IFN signaling attenuates lung damage after irradiation in our RILI model. Thus, our findings indicate that radiation-induced type I IFN induces ILC2-to-ILC1 plasticity to contribute to RILI pathogenesis, and suggest that targeting type I IFN signaling may be a therapeutic strategy to mitigate radiation-induced lung injury.

papers.title_zh: Associations Between Tumor-Left Brachiocephalic Vein Distance and Operative Time in Minimally Invasive Subxiphoid Surgery for Thymoma.
papers.title_en: Associations Between Tumor-Left Brachiocephalic Vein Distance and Operative Time in Minimally Invasive Subxiphoid Surgery for Thymoma.
papers.authors: Kimura T, Miyashita Y, Nagata H, Kimura K, Kanou T, Ose N, Shintani Y
papers.affiliation_highlight: Department of General Thoracic Surgery, The University of Osaka Graduate School of Medicine, Suita, Japan.
papers.abstract_en: INTRODUCTION: Tumor proximity to the left brachiocephalic vein (LBCV) may affect vascular exposure and dissection during the subxiphoid approach (SXA). We investigated the association between tumor-LBCV distance and operative time in patients undergoing subxiphoid robot-assisted or video-assisted thoracoscopic surgery for thymoma. METHODS: Consecutive patients who underwent minimally invasive SXA for thymoma between 2019 and 2024 were retrospectively reviewed. The shortest tumor-LBCV distance (d-LBCV) was measured on preoperative computed tomography. Associations of d-LBCV and tumor size with operative time were evaluated using correlation, interaction, and multivariable linear regression analyses. RESULTS: Among 64 patients with clinical Stage I thymoma without radiological evidence of vascular invasion, 45 and 19 underwent robot- and video-assisted thoracoscopic surgery, respectively. Overall, shorter d-LBCV (r = -0.357, p = 0.0037) and larger tumor size (r = 0.328, p = 0.0082) were correlated with longer operative time. In multivariable analysis adjusting for tumor size, surgical platform, and surgical procedure, shorter d-LBCV remained significantly associated with longer operative time (regression coefficient, -7.62 min per 10-mm increase; 95% CI, -13.21 to -2.03; p = 0.008). Surgical procedure was also significantly associated with operative time, whereas tumor size and surgical platform were not. Although platform-specific analyses showed different association patterns, interaction analyses showed no significant differences between RATS and VATS for tumor size or d-LBCV. CONCLUSION: Shorter d-LBCV was independently associated with longer operative time during minimally invasive SXA for thymoma, despite adjustment for tumor size, surgical platform, and surgical procedure. d-LBCV may provide useful anatomical information for preoperative planning; although further validation is required.

papers.title_en: Lung cancer screening knowledge, attitudes, and practices among primary care providers in Georgia, USA: A survey analysis.
papers.authors: Escoffery C, Lynam M, Kodali T, Hotz J, Anderson S, Haardörfer R, Dupont S, Yanis J et al.
papers.affiliation_highlight: Rollins School of Public Health, Emory University, 1534 Clifton Rd NE, Atlanta, GA 30322, USA.
papers.authors_conclusion: 尽管多数提供者知识充足、态度积极且肺癌筛查服务可及性高，但极少有人开展患者教育或提供戒烟资源；患者教育与临床医生提醒可能是基层肺癌筛查有益的实施策略。

papers.abstract_en: OBJECTIVE: To inform lung cancer screening (LCS) in primary care settings, the study assessed providers' knowledge, attitudes, and practices around LCS and recommended implementation strategies. METHODS: The online survey was administered from May-August 2025 among primary care providers in Georgia, USA. We ran descriptive analyses for all data and linear regression for predictors of greater knowledge. RESULTS: Providers (N = 112) had an average knowledge score of 3.72/5 (SD = 1.11). Physicians (N = 73) scored significantly higher than nurses/nurse practitioners (β = -1.0, 95% CI: -1.6, -0.44). Overall, participants viewed LCS positively, and about 45% reported offering LCS at their facility while 50% reported referring patients to LCS programs. Most (75.5%) had strategies to follow-up with patients who screened positive, but few (22.6%) offered tobacco cessation services. Top barriers were cost, lack of patient knowledge/interest, and transportation; cost assistance, patient education materials, and patient navigation were the top facilitators. Providers (N = 86) identified 'Distributing patient educational materials' and 'Reminding clinicians' as highly feasible and important implementation strategies. CONCLUSIONS: While most providers had sufficient knowledge, positive perceptions, and high availability of LCS services, few engage in patient education or offer smoking cessation resources. Patient education and clinician reminders may be beneficial implementation strategies for primary care-based LCS.

papers.authors: Chen W, Yu Z
papers.affiliation_highlight: Department of Thoracic Surgery, Cancer Hospital of Dalian University of Technology, Liaoning Cancer Hospital & Institute…

papers.abstract_en: With the increase in the diagnosis rate of small pulmonary nodules, the segmentectomy has been increasingly used in clinical practice worldwide. However, for the segmentectomy, the confirmation of intersegmental plane has always puzzled many thoracic surgeons. This paper described a new method, named artery-based Inflation-deflation method, used to confirm the intersegmental border under video-assisted thoracoscopic surgery. After only dividing the targeted segment artery and preserving the targeted segmental veins and bronchi, the intersegmental plane was successfully generated by this novel Inflation-deflation method. Compared with other current methods, this new technique had some advantages including the smaller airway damage, easier to determine the intersegmental plane, the higher fault-tolerant rate and easy to operate without any additional devices. And a further clinical study should be carried out to verify the feasibility and applicability of this new technique.

papers.title_en: Massive enlargement of a previously unrecognized bronchogenic cyst over 8 years with intracystic hemorrhage and complex surgical resection: a case report.
papers.authors: Kobayashi S, Fukui E, Nagata H, Kimura K, Kimura T, Kanou T, Ose N, Shintani Y et al.
papers.affiliation_highlight: Department of General Thoracic Surgery, Graduate School of Medicine, The University of Osaka, 2-2-L5 Yamadaoka, Suita, O…
papers.authors_conclusion: 本病例显示既往未识别的支气管源性囊肿在8年间由4.8 cm显著增大至13 cm，伴囊内出血、症状进展及技术难度较高的手术切除；在决定支气管源性囊肿切除时机时，应考虑其显著增大及手术复杂度增加的可能性

papers.abstract_en: BACKGROUND: Bronchogenic cysts are usually asymptomatic and are often detected incidentally; however, they may become symptomatic due to infection, hemorrhage, or enlargement. We report a case of a previously unrecognized bronchogenic cyst that showed substantial enlargement from 4.8 to 13 cm over an 8-year interval, with intracystic hemorrhage, ultimately requiring partial resection of the esophageal muscularis. CASE PRESENTATION: A man in his 20s presented with upper abdominal pain and nausea. Computed tomography revealed a 13-cm mass extending from below the tracheal bifurcation to the level of the gastric cardia. A CT scan obtained eight years earlier during the evaluation of abdominal pain had shown a 4.8-cm cystic lesion below the tracheal bifurcation, demonstrating substantial enlargement over the intervening period. Although conservative treatment was attempted, compressive symptoms persisted; therefore, surgical resection was performed for definitive diagnosis and symptom relief. Severe inflammatory adhesions necessitated right open thoracotomy with partial resection of the esophageal muscularis. The cyst contained a large hematoma, and histopathological examination confirmed the diagnosis of a bronchogenic cyst with intracystic hemorrhage. CONCLUSION: This case demonstrates substantial enlargement of a previously unrecognized bronchogenic cyst from 4.8 to 13 cm over an 8-year interval, with intracystic hemorrhage, symptomatic progression, and technically demanding surgical resection. The potential for substantial enlargement and increasing surgical complexity should be considered when determining the timing of resection for bronchogenic cysts.

papers.abstract_en: Chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (COPD) is characterized by airflow limitation, dynamic hyperinflation, and intrinsic positive end-expiratory pressure (iPEEP), which increase inspiratory threshold load and complicate ventilatory support. Non-invasive ventilation (NIV) is the preferred initial ventilatory support for COPD exacerbations complicated by acute or acute-on-chronic respiratory acidosis, while invasive mechanical ventilation (IMV) may be required when NIV fails. External PEEP may reduce the inspiratory threshold load in patients with expiratory flow limitation, although excessive levels can increase lung volume and compromise hemodynamics. During IMV, PEEP adjustment requires assessment of respiratory mechanics, expiratory flow, hyperinflation, and cardiovascular tolerance. During NIV, where iPEEP cannot usually be measured directly, expiratory positive airway pressure (EPAP) should be adjusted according to clinical response, patient-ventilator interaction, and signs of excessive lung inflation. Inappropriate ventilatory assistance may also contribute to diaphragm dysfunction. Diaphragm ultrasound allows bedside assessment of muscle thickness and inspiratory thickening fraction (DTF), although these measurements are influenced by ventilatory assistance, respiratory drive, and lung volume. This review examines the physiological basis, available evidence, and limitations of using diaphragm ultrasound to complement PEEP adjustment in patients with COPD and dynamic hyperinflation. No DTF target or clinical benefit of ultrasound-guided PEEP titration has been established in this population.

papers.study_type: 多中心回顾性生物标志物分析（H&E、多重免疫荧光及空间分析）

papers.title_en: Spatial and maturational characterisation of tertiary lymphoid structures predicts immunotherapy response in extensive-stage small cell lung cancer.
papers.authors: Wang H, Shang X, Jiang Y, Zhao C, Li Z, Zhang C, Xu Q, Du S et al.
papers.affiliation_highlight: Department of Internal Medicine-Oncology, Shandong Cancer Hospital and Institute Shandong First Medical University and S…
papers.authors_conclusion: TLS成熟度与空间构架可能作为与ICI治疗ES-SCLC患者临床结局相关的候选组织生物标志物，值得结合SCLC分子分型进行前瞻性验证
papers.ai_note: 研究称TLS具有“预测”价值，但队列全部接受ICI治疗、无未接受ICI的对照，无法区分预后与疗效预测，缺乏交互作用检验；成熟TLS与非成熟TLS的比较仅报告P值，未见效应量、置信区间及多因素校正；应答者空间特征分析为横断面比较，存在选择与多重比较问题；TLS阳性仅22.2%，亚组样本量有限；无外部验证；空间距离等结果未给出具体数值与统计量
papers.abstract_en: OBJECTIVES: Extensive-stage small cell lung cancer (ES-SCLC) remains an aggressive malignancy with limited durable responses to immune checkpoint inhibitors (ICIs) and no established predictive biomarkers. This study aimed to evaluate the prognostic and predictive value of tertiary lymphoid structures (TLSs) in patients with ES-SCLC receiving ICI-based therapy. METHODS: In this multicenter retrospective study of 180 treatment-naïve ES-SCLC patients subsequently receiving ICI-based therapy, TLSs were systematically evaluated using H&E staining, multiplex immunofluorescence, and spatial analysis to determine their prognostic and predictive value. RESULTS: TLSs were identified in 22.2% of cases and independently associated with improved overall survival (OS) in both univariate (HR = 0.365, 95% CI: 0.217-0.613, P < 0.001) and multivariate (HR = 0.337, 95% CI: 0.199-0.569, P < 0.001) analyses. Crucially, TLS maturation status was associated with clinical outcomes, as patients with mature TLSs containing CD21+ follicular dendritic cells and organized germinal centers experienced significantly longer survival than those with non-mature TLSs (P = 0.0049). Beyond mere presence, responders to ICIs exhibited distinct spatial characteristics, including higher TLS densities, denser immune infiltration, and shorter distances between TLS-resident CD20+ B cells, CD3+ T cells, and tumor cells, suggesting that immune-tumor spatial organization within TLSs reflects functional antitumor engagement. CONCLUSION: TLS maturation and spatial architecture may serve as candidate tissue biomarkers associated with clinical outcomes in ICI-treated ES-SCLC, warranting prospective validation alongside SCLC molecular subtyping.

papers.study_type: 单中心前瞻性描述性队列 · 诊疗路径映射与访谈
papers.title_zh: 农村食管癌患者诊疗路径延迟与碎片化：单中心前瞻性描述性队列
papers.title_en: The Journey of Care for Rural Esophageal Cancer Patients.
papers.authors: Yang E, Kalmeta S, Goodwin N
papers.affiliation_highlight: Department of Surgery, Asante Three Rivers Medical Center, Grants Pass, OR, USA.
papers.authors_conclusion: Rural esophageal cancer patients endure prolonged, fragmented, and variable care journeys. Surgical patients, in particular, face delays before esophagectomy. Rural research provides valuable insights for tailoring broader interventions for rural communities. In partnership, rural centers and universities provide both bottom-up and top-down perspectives in defragmenting rural esophageal cancer care.
papers.ai_note: 单中心小样本描述性研究，无对照与风险调整；手术患者亚组例数未报告，新辅助至手术延迟的稳健性信息不足；转移性患者治疗更快可能受治疗目标与路径差异影响，摘要未说明校正；访谈3个月结果未量化呈现；时间间隔依赖患者报告与路径映射，回忆偏倚与选择偏倚信息不足。
papers.abstract_en: BackgroundRural esophageal cancer patients experience both fragmented and delayed care. One-size-fits-all interventions aimed at rural communities can be ineffective, as they can vary significantly in population, geographic isolation, and medical specialty availability. Therefore, as a rural health care center, we analyzed the journey of care for our esophageal cancer patients to better understand and serve our community. We aimed to create a framework for how to approach and analyze this complex care continuum for other small communities.MethodsEsophageal cancer patients receiving care at a rural cancer center from September 2024 to April 2025 were enrolled. Care journeys were mapped from symptom onset through treatment. Interviews occurred at enrollment and 3 months.ResultsTwenty-seven patients were enrolled. Nearly half (48%) presented with metastatic disease. Patients on average reported symptoms 85 days after onset, were diagnosed 137 days after onset, and started treatment 48 day after diagnosis. Metastatic patients experienced shorter times to treatment (72 vs 128 days, P = 0.014) compared to locoregional patients. Surgical patients averaged 57 days from diagnosis to starting neoadjuvant treatment, followed by 97 days from completing neoadjuvant treatment to esophagectomy. Patients reported disempowerment, difficulty navigating the medical system, and a lack of awareness before diagnosis.ConclusionsRural esophageal cancer patients endure prolonged, fragmented, and variable care journeys. Surgical patients, in particular, face delays before esophagectomy. Rural research provides valuable insights for tailoring broader interventions for rural communities. In partnership, rural centers and universities provide both bottom-up and top-down perspectives in defragmenting rural esophageal cancer care.

papers.study_type: Narrative review（叙述性综述）· 非系统综述
papers.category_label: 局晚期与晚期靶向/免疫
papers.title_zh: 胸膜间皮瘤免疫抑制性肿瘤微环境与免疫检查点抑制剂耐药：机制及治疗策略综述
papers.title_en: Reprogramming the tumor microenvironment in mesothelioma: from immune suppression to therapeutic opportunity.
papers.authors: Cerbone L, Garau A, Balossino A, Martinotti S, Ranzato E, Genova C, Rigo V, Meda S et al.
papers.affiliation_highlight: SSD Mesotelioma, Melanoma e Tumori Rari, IRCCS AOU SS Antonio e Biagio e Cesare Arrigo, Alessandria, Italy.
papers.authors_conclusion: Novel therapeutic strategies aimed at depleting or modulating suppressive immune populations within the TME are emerging as promising avenues to overcome resistance and enhance the effectiveness of ICIs.
papers.ai_note: 叙述性综述，无系统检索、定量合成或偏倚评估；摘要未给出纳入研究数量及效应量；“promising avenues”属作者观点，需原始研究验证。
papers.abstract_en: Pleural mesothelioma (PM) is a rare and aggressive cancer with limited treatment options and poor prognosis. Unlike other thoracic cancers responding well to immunotherapy, PM typically lacks key predictive biomarkers such as Programmed Death-Ligand 1 (PD-L1) tumor expression. Nonetheless, immune checkpoint inhibitors (ICIs) have shown clinical activity in PM, particularly in non-epithelioid subtypes. However, only a subset of patients benefits from this approach, and resistance remains a major challenge. A growing body of evidence suggests that tumor microenvironment (TME) plays a central role in shaping this resistance. In PM, the TME is notably immunosuppressive, dominated by regulatory T cells, myeloid-derived suppressor cells, and tumor-associated macrophages. These elements act as a shield against immune activation, limiting the efficacy of ICIs. Novel therapeutic strategies aimed at depleting or modulating suppressive immune populations within the TME are emerging as promising avenues to overcome resistance and enhance the effectiveness of ICIs. In this narrative review, we examine the unique features of the TME in PM, its role in immunotherapy resistance, and emerging strategies aimed at harnessing or remodeling the TME to improve patient outcomes.

papers.study_type: 队列研究（启发式判定）
papers.title_zh: scTIME: single-cell-informed interpretable modeling of immunotherapy-associated immune states in non-small cell lung cancer.
papers.title_en: scTIME: single-cell-informed interpretable modeling of immunotherapy-associated immune states in non-small cell lung cancer.
papers.authors: Chen G, You C, Gao H, Xu C
papers.affiliation_highlight: YongJia People's Hospital, Wenzhou, China.
papers.abstract_en: Immune checkpoint inhibitor response in non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC) reflects coordinated tumor and immune states that are not fully captured by single biomarkers. We developed scTIME, an interpretable model that translates single-cell immune programs into bulk transcriptomic scores, and integrated public single-cell, T-cell receptor, transcriptomic, survival, and proteogenomic cohorts. Response modeling used two cohorts with different endpoints (40 patients) and compared six algorithms. ElasticNet was selected as a sparse reporting model, achieving a pooled five-fold out-of-fold ROC-AUC of 0.810; nested model selection yielded 0.772. Matched held-out stratification identified response-enriched scTIME groups in a direct descriptive comparison with CD274, while the fitted score emphasized cytotoxic CD8, natural killer, SPP1 macrophage, interferon-response, and antigen-presentation programs. Single-cell analyses and external projections linked these programs to CXCL10-CXCR3 recruitment, exclusion-associated states, and T-cell receptor ecology across molecular contexts. Exploratory survival and cross-omics analyses extended the framework beyond the response cohorts but were interpreted as projection rather than independent validation. Together, the results show how cell-resolved immune biology can support transparent, multi-omic biomarker development without reducing response to a single pathway. scTIME remains exploratory because model choice was post hoc, cohorts were small and clinically heterogeneous, and endpoint-matched external validation was unavailable.

papers.study_type: 基础实验研究：小鼠在体机械通气模型（Control/LVT/HVT）+ RAW264.7巨噬细胞体外功能获得/缺失实验
papers.title_zh: 高潮气量机械通气通过巨噬细胞BMPRIB-p38/NF-κB轴促进小鼠肺内炎症与肺损伤
papers.title_en: Macrophage BMPRIB mediates p38-dependent inflammatory reprogramming and chemotaxis during ventilator-induced lung injury.
papers.authors: Wang J, Sun Q, Li L, Xu J, Yang L
papers.affiliation_highlight: Department of Anesthesiology, The Second Xiangya Hospital, Central South University, Changsha, Hunan, China.
papers.authors_conclusion: HVT-induced BMPRIB upregulation in lung macrophages allows BMP4 to activate BMPRIB-dependent p38/NF-κB p65 axis as a key mediator of macrophage-driven inflammation in VILI. Targeting the BMPRIB-dependent p38/NF-κB axis may represent a novel therapeutic strategy.
papers.ai_note: 摘要通篇为定性描述，缺样本量、缺统计量与效应值，无法判断差异幅度与可重复性；核心论据“HVT选择性上调BMPRIB而下调BMPRII、BMPRIA不变”未给出定量与统计支持；气管内给予外源BMP4属超生理刺激，“BMP4-BMPRIB-p38/NF-κB”链条主要依赖药理学抑制剂（LDN193189、SB202190）交叉验证，存在脱靶可能；未见人肺组织或临床VILI标本验证；“novel therapeutic strategy”为由小鼠+细胞系结果的外推表述。
papers.abstract_en: BACKGROUND: Ventilator-induced lung injury (VILI) is a major iatrogenic complication of mechanical ventilation, in which dysregulated inflammation, particularly macrophage-driven response, amplifies pulmonary damage. Although bone morphogenetic protein (BMP) signaling exhibits context-dependent effects in pulmonary disorders, whether specific BMP receptors (BMPRs) regulate macrophage function during VILI remains unknown. METHODS: Mice subjected to mechanical ventilation were randomly divided into Control (intubation without ventilation), LVT (low tidal volume), and HVT (high tidal volume) groups. HVT-exposed mice received intratracheal administration of exogenous BMP4 or the BMP type I receptor antagonist LDN193189. Lung injury severity was assessed by ultrasound, macroscopic scoring, wet/dry ratio, and histopathology. Macrophage accumulation, M1/M2 polarization, interstitial-to-alveolar macrophage (IM/AM) ratio, and BMP receptor expression were evaluated. Transcriptomic profiling was performed to identify differentially expressed genes and enriched pathways. In vitro, gain- and loss-of-function experiments (overexpression and knockdown of BMPRIB) were conducted in RAW264.7 macrophages to assess cytokine/chemokine production, migration, and MAPK pathway activation. The p38 inhibitor SB202190 was used to probe downstream signaling. RESULTS: Compared with Control and LVT groups, HVT induced time-dependent macrophage accumulation, skewed M1/M2 polarization, and a progressive elevation of the IM/AM ratio. Strikingly, HVT selectively upregulated BMPRIB in lung macrophages, while downregulating BMPRII and leaving BMPRIA unchanged. Intratracheal BMP4 exacerbated these effects, whereas LDN193189 reversed BMP4-induced macrophage accumulation, M1 polarization, IM/AM elevation, and suppressed activation of ERK, JNK, p38, and p65 signaling. Transcriptomic analysis revealed that BMP4 enriched MAPK and inflammation-related pathways, with LDN193189 co-treatment partially reversing this enrichment. In BMP4-stimulated RAW264.7 macrophages, BMPRIB overexpression enhanced, whereas BMPRIB knockdown attenuated, cytokine/chemokine production and migration. Pharmacological p38 inhibition (SB202190) abrogated BMP4-induced pro-inflammatory effects in macrophages. CONCLUSIONS: HVT-induced BMPRIB upregulation in lung macrophages allows BMP4 to activate BMPRIB-dependent p38/NF-κB p65 axis as a key mediator of macrophage-driven inflammation in VILI Targeting the BMPRIB-dependent p38/NF-κB axis may represent a novel therapeutic strategy.

papers.study_type: 批判性叙述综述（非系统综述）· 证据合成
papers.title_zh: 重建感知影像组学对亚实性肺结节风险分层的临床价值尚缺乏前瞻性证据：批判性叙述综述
papers.title_en: Reconstruction-aware radiomics for risk stratification of subsolid pulmonary nodules: technical evidence, clinical limits, and translation priorities.
papers.authors: Liu Y, Peng Y, Chen F, Huang J, Yang J, Zhong J
papers.affiliation_highlight: Department of Radiology, Zigong First People's Hospital, Zigong, Sichuan, China.
papers.authors_conclusion: Translation therefore requires reconstruction and segmentation robustness testing, strong conventional comparators, external calibration, prespecified thresholds, and prospective decision-linked evaluation. Until such benefit and safety are demonstrated, reconstruction-aware radiomics should remain investigational or confined to governed, domain-checked decision-support pathways.
papers.ai_note: 叙述性综述，未报告系统检索策略、纳入研究数量及偏倚评估，无法判断证据合成的完整性；“未发现前瞻性研究”属文献回顾性判断而非系统检索结果；结论谨慎且与所述证据一致，但缺乏定量合成。
papers.abstract_en: Subsolid pulmonary nodules (SSNs), including pure ground-glass nodules (pGGNs) and part-solid nodules (PSNs), span transient inflammatory abnormalities and adenocarcinoma-spectrum lesions with widely different management implications. This critical narrative review treats CT reconstruction as part of the quantitative biomarker definition and asks whether targeted or high-spatial-resolution reconstruction provides stable, task-specific information beyond standardized thin-section CT. Evidence was synthesized across direct SSN reconstruction-domain studies, technical robustness studies, and clinical prediction studies. Direct imaging studies support improved depiction of selected fine structures, while same-scan GGN evidence demonstrates substantial pixel-size dependence of radiomic features and model composition. However, most clinical models were not evaluated in paired reconstruction domains, external validation with calibration remains uncommon, and no prospective study demonstrating management or patient benefit from reconstruction-aware radiomics in SSNs was identified in the literature reviewed. Persistent pGGNs provide a biological and technical rationale for investigating incremental quantitative information, but greater benefit than in PSNs has not been demonstrated. In PSNs, any model must add value beyond solid-component measurements, consolidation-to-tumor ratio, morphology, and longitudinal growth. Translation therefore requires reconstruction and segmentation robustness testing, strong conventional comparators, external calibration, prespecified thresholds, and prospective decision-linked evaluation. Until such benefit and safety are demonstrated, reconstruction-aware radiomics should remain investigational or confined to governed, domain-checked decision-support pathways.

papers.study_type: 叙述性综述（非系统评价，无检索策略与定量合成）
papers.title_zh: 食管癌免疫治疗耐药的分子机制与克服策略：一篇非系统性综述
papers.title_en: Molecular mechanisms and therapeutic strategies of immunotherapy resistance in esophageal cancer.
papers.authors: Pang Y, Jiang P, Liu K, Suo X, Zhang D, Xu Y, Ge Y, Fu Q et al.
papers.affiliation_highlight: Key Laboratory of Microbiome and Esophageal Cancer Prevention and Treatment, The First Affiliated Hospital, and College …
papers.authors_conclusion: 本综述全面分析了食管癌免疫治疗耐药的分子机制，包括CAF/TAM及免疫抑制细胞群介导的TME重塑、糖/氨基酸/脂质代谢重编程、DNA甲基化/组蛋白修饰/非编码RNA的表观遗传调控及代偿性免疫检查点上调；并强调微生物组的新兴作用，批判性评估了抗血管生成药物、ADC及多组学与类器官模型指导的个体化联合策略等克服耐药的方案。
papers.ai_note: 本文为叙述性综述，摘要未交代文献检索范围、纳入排除标准、筛选流程与证据分级，无法判断是否存在选择性引用；全文无任何原始数据、效应量或置信区间，机制归类（TME/代谢/表观遗传/微生物组）与联合策略清单的完整性不可核验；将'克服耐药'的联合策略表述为已有前景但未给出其证据等级，存在把早期/临床前证据与确证性证据混同的风险；信息不足，无法评估其结论稳健性。
papers.abstract_en: Immunotherapy, particularly immune checkpoint inhibitors (ICIs), has transformed the treatment landscape for advanced esophageal cancer (EC). Nevertheless, clinical benefits are constrained by primary and acquired resistance driven by a dynamic immunosuppressive tumor microenvironment (TME), extensive metabolic reprogramming, and epigenetic dysregulation. This review provides a comprehensive analysis of the molecular mechanisms underlying immunotherapy resistance in EC, including TME remodeling by cancer-associated fibroblasts, tumor-associated macrophages, and immunosuppressive cell populations; metabolic reprogramming encompassing glucose, amino acid, and lipid metabolism; epigenetic regulation involving DNA methylation, histone modifications, and non-coding RNAs; and compensatory immune checkpoint upregulation. We further highlight the emerging role of the microbiome and critically evaluate combination strategies designed to overcome resistance, including anti-angiogenic agents, ADCs, and personalized approaches guided by multi-omics and organoid models.

papers.study_type: 研究类型待评定（启发式模式）
papers.category_label: 局晚期与晚期靶向/免疫
papers.title_zh: TREM2+ macrophages mediate anticancer therapy-induced immune evasion in lung adenocarcinoma via the CCL5/CCL22-Treg axis.
papers.title_en: TREM2+ macrophages mediate anticancer therapy-induced immune evasion in lung adenocarcinoma via the CCL5/CCL22-Treg axis.
papers.authors: Kim CY, Cha YJ, Park MK, Chang YS
papers.affiliation_highlight: Department of Internal Medicine, Yonsei University College of Medicine, Seoul, Republic of Korea.
papers.abstract_en: INTRODUCTION: Osimertinib and cisplatin are widely used as standard treatments for non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC); however, their effects on tumor microenvironment remodeling remain poorly understood. This study investigated whether TREM2-positive tumor-associated macrophages (TAMs) promote immune evasion through the CCL5/CCL22-CCR5/CCR4-Treg axis under anticancer treatment. METHODS: The spatial and quantitative correlations between TREM2+ and FOXP3+ cells were assessed using NSCLC patient-derived single-cell RNA sequencing (scRNA-seq) datasets, human lung adenocarcinoma tissue microarrays, and cisplatin-treated mouse lung cancer models. Mediators linking TREM2+ and FOXP3+ cells were identified by cell-cell communication analysis using CellChat and gene expression profiling of THP-1-derived macrophages treated with osimertinib or cisplatin, with validation in bone marrow-derived macrophages. RESULTS: scRNA-seq dataset analysis showed significantly enriched TREM2+ and FOXP3+ cells in lung adenocarcinoma tissues compared with adjacent normal lung, with a significant positive correlation at the aggregated single-cell level (Spearman's rho = 0.7323, P < 0.001). CCL5 and CCL22 were identified as key mediators linking TREM2+ TAMs and FOXP3+ Tregs and were markedly induced by treatment but suppressed by TREM2 knockdown or pharmacologic inhibition. TREM2 overexpression further enhanced their induction. Mechanistically, CCL22 induction was broadly dependent on SYK, Src, AKT, NF-κB, or STAT3 signaling pathways, whereas CCL5 upregulation depended on Src, NF-κB, and STAT3, with SYK involvement varying by cell type. In the orthotopic Lewis lung carcinoma (LLC) model, Trem2 inhibition reduced Treg infiltration and mitigated chemotherapy-associated immune evasion. CONCLUSION: These findings indicate that TREM2+ TAMs drive CCL5/CCL22-mediated Treg recruitment and support targeting TREM2 to enhance therapeutic efficacy of standard NSCLC treatments.

papers.study_type: 队列研究（启发式判定）
papers.title_zh: Obesity and the risk of idiopathic pulmonary fibrosis: a nationwide population-based study.
papers.title_en: Obesity and the risk of idiopathic pulmonary fibrosis: a nationwide population-based study.
papers.authors: Kim M, Lee KN, Shin DW, Han K, Lee SW
papers.affiliation_highlight: Department of Pulmonary and Critical Care Medicine, Asan Medical Center, University of Ulsan Colledge of Medicine, Songp…
papers.abstract_en: BACKGROUND: Obesity is a chronic inflammatory and metabolic condition implicated in the pathogenesis of several fibrotic diseases. However, population-based evidence regarding the association between obesity and the risk of idiopathic pulmonary fibrosis (IPF) remains limited. METHODS: This is a nationwide population-based cohort study using the National Health Information Database of South Korea. Adults aged ≥20 years who participated in the National Health Screening Program in 2012 were included. Individuals with prevalent IPF or those diagnosed within 1 year after baseline were excluded. Obesity was assessed using body mass index (BMI ≥25 kg/m² by Asian criteria) and waist circumference (WC). Incident IPF was defined by insurance claims with the International Classification of Diseases, 10th Revision code J84.1 in conjunction with registration in the Rare Intractable Diseases programme. RESULTS: Among 4 788 202 participants followed for a mean of 10.15 years, 1 591 830 (33.2%) were classified as obese. Higher BMI was associated with an increased risk of IPF in a dose–response manner after multivariable adjustment. Compared with participants with BMI 18.5–22.9 kg/m², adjusted HRs for IPF were 1.25 (95% CI 1.16 to 1.35) for BMI 23–24.9 kg/m², 1.55 (95% CI 1.45 to 1.66) for BMI 25–29.9 kg/m² and 1.66 (95% CI 1.42 to 1.94) for BMI ≥30 kg/m². In contrast, underweight individuals (BMI <18.5 kg/m²) had a lower risk of IPF. WC demonstrated a similar trend, with higher values independently associated with increased IPF risk. CONCLUSIONS: In this large nationwide cohort, both general and abdominal obesity were independently associated with an increased risk of incident IPF. These findings provide population-based evidence supporting a potential role of increased adiposity in IPF pathogenesis.

papers.study_type: 队列研究（启发式判定）
papers.title_zh: Automated quantitative analysis can support the identification of progressive pulmonary fibrosis in fibrotic interstitial lung disease.
papers.title_en: Automated quantitative analysis can support the identification of progressive pulmonary fibrosis in fibrotic interstitial lung disease.
papers.authors: Janska E, Dixon G, Page J, Hartley TM, Sturney SC, Harper JC, Tsaneva-Atanasova K, Gibbons MA et al.
papers.affiliation_highlight: University of Bristol Medical School, Bristol, UK.
papers.abstract_en: BACKGROUND: Identifying progression in fibrotic interstitial lung disease (f-ILD) is essential for treatment decisions and prognostication. Quantitative CT (qCT) may improve detection of progressive pulmonary fibrosis (PPF). We evaluated whether routine qCT enhances identification of disease progression. METHODS: We conducted a retrospective observational study of patients presenting to an ILD service over 2 years. Patients with f-ILD who underwent two CT scans within 24 months prior to ILD multidisciplinary team (ILD-MDT) review were included. CTs were initially reported by a mixed pool of radiologists and subsequently reviewed by an expert thoracic radiologist at ILD-MDT. The contextflow ADVANCE Chest CT was used to quantify lung abnormalities. The cohort was divided 70:30 into derivation and validation sets, stratified by ILD-MDT-defined progression. In the derivation cohort, optimal qCT thresholds were defined using Youden’s index and applied to the validation cohort to assess detection of previously unreported progression. RESULTS: 127/502 patients met inclusion criteria and were stratified into derivation (n=89) and validation (n=38) cohorts. In the derivation cohort, a 0.39% increase in combined honeycombing and reticulation yielded an AUC of 0.64 for identifying progression. In the validation cohort, this threshold achieved sensitivity and specificity of 0.71 for PPF detection. Although 27/38 (71.1%) patients were initially reported as stable or without comment on progression, 12/27 (44.4%) were later classified as having radiological progression at ILD-MDT. Of these discordant cases, qCT correctly identified progression in 10/12 (83.3%). DISCUSSION: This study demonstrates that qCT may assist the non-specialist radiologist in identifying fibrotic disease progression enabling earlier access to appropriate treatment.

papers.study_type: 队列研究（启发式判定）
papers.title_zh: Area-level socioeconomic deprivation and cause-specific survival after lung cancer diagnosis: a population-based cohort study in Naples, Italy.
papers.title_en: Area-level socioeconomic deprivation and cause-specific survival after lung cancer diagnosis: a population-based cohort study in Naples, Italy.
papers.authors: Scala A, Cristillo S, Loperto I, Gubitosi M, Ortolani R, Improta G
papers.affiliation_highlight: Department of Public Health, University of Naples Federico II, Naples, Italy.
papers.abstract_en: BACKGROUND: Lung cancer remains a major public health priority, with survival shaped by clinical, behavioral, socioeconomic, and organizational factors. Socioeconomic disadvantage may affect risk exposure, diagnosis, treatment access, continuity of care, and data completeness. OBJECTIVE: To assess the association between area-level socioeconomic deprivation and cause-specific survival in lung cancer and apply the M.A.S.T.E.R. (Methodological Approach for Strategic Transformation, Evaluation, and Redesign) framework to translate epidemiological evidence into organizational design and implementation planning. METHODS: A retrospective population-based registry cohort study within ASL Napoli 1 Centro included incident malignant tumors of the trachea, lung, and bronchi recorded between 2010 and 2023. Cancer Registry data were integrated with the 2021 Socioeconomic Disadvantage Index (IDISE), Hospital Discharge Records, and progressi delle Aziende Sanitarie per la Salute in Italia (PASSI) 2022-2024 contextual smoking prevalence by sex and Primary Health Care District (DSB). Cause-specific survival was analyzed using multivariable Cox regression with district-clustered robust variance; Fine-Gray competing-risk regression was used as sensitivity analysis. M.A.S.T.E.R. comprised six phases: Mapping and contextualization, analysis and diagnosis, strategic design, testing and adaptive execution, embedding and sustainability, and resilience and renewal. RESULTS: Of 11,162 cases, 10,039 were included in the main analysis, totaling 207,600 person-months. There were 8,514 deaths, including 6,990 cause-specific deaths. In the primary model without contextual smoking prevalence, adjusted hazard ratios (HRs) increased across deprivation quintiles (Q5 vs. Q1: HR 1.11; 95% CI: 1.05-1.18; p < 0.001). Adding PASSI smoking prevalence attenuated the estimates (Q5 vs. Q1: HR 1.09; 95% CI: 0.99-1.19; p = 0.069); smoking prevalence was not statistically associated with mortality. M.A.S.T.E.R. outputs included a qualitative failure mode and effects analysis (FMEA), a plan, do, study, act (PDSA) protocol with control plan, a completeness dashboard, and plans for updates, audits, and strategic review. CONCLUSIONS: Greater area-level socioeconomic deprivation was associated with higher cause-specific mortality in the primary model; the association was attenuated and no longer statistically significant after adding contextual PASSI smoking prevalence. M.A.S.T.E.R. clarified the transition from epidemiological analysis to candidate interventions for prevention, smoking cessation, early diagnosis, patient navigation, and information integration. Outputs from the final four phases are design-oriented and require prospective implementation and validation.

papers.title_zh: Targeted therapy use following Medicare's coverage expansion for next-generation sequencing in older adults with lung cancer.
papers.title_en: Targeted therapy use following Medicare's coverage expansion for next-generation sequencing in older adults with lung cancer.
papers.authors: Kang SY, Roney PC, Ahn J, Lobo T, Gresenz CR, Potosky AL, Kinney AY, Schwartz MD et al.
papers.affiliation_highlight: Department of Health Management and Policy, Georgetown University School of Health, Washington, DC, United States.
papers.abstract_en: PURPOSE: To examine whether Medicare's 2018 National Coverage Determination (NCD) for next-generation sequencing (NGS) was associated with changes in the use of targeted oral anticancer therapies among older adults with lung cancer. METHODS: Retrospective cohort study. Multivariable logistic regression was used to estimate the probability of initiating an oral targeted therapy within 12 months of diagnosis. Key exposures were (1) diagnosis before versus after the NCD and (2) residence in a region with versus without pre-NCD NGS. Data were drawn from the SEER-Medicare linked data with Part D claims, including diagnosis years 2016-2019 with follow-up through 2020. The analytic sample included Medicare fee-for-service Part D beneficiaries aged 65 years or older with newly diagnosed lung cancer. RESULTS: Among 30,855 Medicare fee-for-service Part D beneficiaries with lung cancer, 7.1% used targeted oral anticancer therapies. The NCD was not associated with a significant overall change in targeted therapy use (0.4 Percentage Point; 95% CI, -1.6 to 2.4; p = 0.71). Before NCD implementation, targeted therapy use was 1.0 PP higher in regions with pre-NCD NGS coverage than in regions without such coverage (95% CI, 0.2-1.9; p = 0.015). In stage-stratified analyses, the additional post-NCD change was significant among patients with distant-stage disease (3.2 PPs; 95% CI, 2.6-4.0; p < 0.001) but not among those with regional-stage disease (p = 0.29). CONCLUSIONS: Medicare's NCD for NGS was not associated with a significant overall increase in targeted oral anticancer therapy use but was associated with increased use among patients with distant-stage disease. Targeted therapy use remained higher in regions with preexisting NGS coverage.

papers.title_zh: 手性与形貌调控的金纳米颗粒递送 PD-L1 siRNA 在 H460 肺癌模型中增强基因沉默和抑瘤
papers.title_en: Chirality and morphology-dependent siRNA delivery for targeted lung cancer therapy with intrinsically chiral gold nanoparticles.
papers.authors: Li Q, Xu J, Zhang E, Liu C, Liu W, Yan K, Xu D, Wang J et al.
papers.affiliation_highlight: Key Laboratory of Biomedical Analytics (Southwest University), Chongqing Science and Technology Bureau, College of Pharm…
papers.authors_conclusion: 手性和形貌是可共同设计的基因递送参数，并为将手性纳米材料转化为实体瘤治疗提供机制蓝图。
papers.ai_note: 摘要未报告样本量、统计检验、效应量及安全性/毒性数据；主要结论基于 H460 细胞和单一动物模型，外推至实体瘤治疗需更多验证；“mechanistic blueprint”表述偏乐观。
papers.abstract_en: The clinical translation of RNA interference (RNAi) for lung cancer treatment remains hampered by the lack of delivery vectors that concurrently optimize cellular uptake, target specificity, and in vivo stability. This work reports an intrinsically chiral gold nanoparticle (Au NP) platform with precisely controlled morphology for targeted siRNA delivery. Through a full 2 × 2 factorial design (2 chiralities × 2 morphologies), the work decouples the individual and combined contributions of these two parameters. It is found that right-handed chiral nanoparticles (D-NPs) show significantly faster cellular internalization and higher gene silencing potency than left-handed (L-NPs) and achiral (DL-NPs) counterparts. Beyond chirality, nanoparticle morphology serves as an equally critical parameter: the rhombicuboctahedral (RCO) architecture yields markedly higher silencing efficacy than cubic counterparts with D-chirality. Furthermore, proteomic analysis revealed that Au RCO nanoparticles with different chirality displayed distinct functional enrichment profiles. By D-RCO combination with minimal surface modification, siRNA targeting PD-L1 achieves potent knockdown and robust inhibition of H460 lung cancer proliferation both in vitro and in vivo. This work establishes chirality and morphology as co-designable parameters for gene delivery and provides a mechanistic blueprint for translating chiral nanomaterials into solid tumor therapy.

papers.study_type: 单细胞转录组与TCGA-LUAD队列生物信息学分析 · 体外验证的探索性机制研究

papers.title_zh: 单细胞分析提示晚期肺癌恶性积液中上皮细胞炎症信号受抑、干性增强，STMN1与干性维持相关
papers.title_en: Single-Cell Dissection of Inflammatory Suppression and Stemness Plasticity Reveals STMN1-Associated Malignant Epithelial Cells in Severe Lung Cancer.
papers.authors: Chen Y, Chen S, Cheng B, Tang Y, Huang Y, Chen M
papers.affiliation_highlight: Department of Endocrinology, The Affiliated Yongchuan Hospital of Chongqing Medical University, Chongqing, China.
papers.authors_conclusion: 本研究揭示晚期肺癌恶性上皮细胞干性状态显著增强，伴炎症信号受抑和代谢适应增强，并确定STMN1是驱动干性维持和疾病进展的关键分子。
papers.ai_note: 摘要未给出样本量、干性评分或相关性分析的具体数值与统计量；将相关网络、通路富集及体外标志物上调解读为STMN1驱动疾病进展，因果性证据有限；“mRNAi”含义不明；“severe lung cancer”定义不清；缺乏生存、治疗反应等临床终点及独立外部验证信息。
papers.abstract_en: The disease course in patients with advanced lung cancer with malignant serous effusions (ALC-MSE) is complex, and treatment outcomes are difficult to predict; systematic studies on the tumor stem cell-like characteristics and regulatory mechanisms of this condition are still lacking. Based on single-cell transcriptomic data and the TCGA-LUAD cohort, this study systematically analyzed the functional characteristics and key regulatory networks of malignant epithelial cells in severe lung cancer. Key findings include: epithelial cells in severe lung cancer exhibit significantly attenuated inflammation- and immunity-related signaling pathways (including NF-κB, TNF, and JAK-STAT signaling pathways), enhanced stem cell-like properties, and metabolic reprogramming; we identified a highly stem-like malignant epithelial cell subpopulation, represented by Cluster 3, which is enriched in stem-like pathways such as Notch, Hippo, TGF-β, and FoxO, and is accompanied by enhanced mitochondrial metabolism and stress adaptability; STMN1 is a key molecule regulating this stem-like state, showing a significant positive correlation with stemness scores and mRNAi; cells with high STMN1 expression gain a survival advantage and may maintain their stemness by attenuating CAF/ECM signaling with other cells (COL1A1-CD44), inhibiting complement activation and antigen presentation signaling (such as C3, ANXA1, and MHC-II-related molecules), and enhancing stemness niche signaling (MIF-CD74/CD44). Furthermore, NELFE, MYBL2, FOXN3, POLR2A, and RAD21 were identified as potential upstream regulators of STMN1. In vitro experiments confirmed that, following induction of stem cell-like properties, STMN1 was significantly overexpressed in lung adenocarcinoma cells, accompanied by upregulation of related stem cell markers (SOX2, NANOG, OCT4, and CD44). In summary, this study reveals a significantly enhanced stemness state in malignant epithelial cells in advanced lung cancer, accompanied by suppressed inflammatory signaling and enhanced metabolic adaptation, and identifies STMN1 as a key molecule driving stemness maintenance and disease progression.

papers.study_type: 叙述性综述（非系统评价）· 细胞学/小活检诊断路径与免疫细胞化学panel应用

papers.title_zh: 综述：细胞学与小活检样本中非小细胞肺癌及其类似病变的诊断思路——与WHO报告系统对接的形态学与免疫细胞化学实践要点（无原始数据）
papers.title_en: Non-small cell lung carcinoma and its mimics on cytology and small biopsy samples: a practical approach aligned with the WHO Reporting System.
papers.authors: Silva RSD, Schmitt F
papers.affiliation_highlight: IPATIMUP Diagnostics, IPATIMUP - Institute of Molecular Pathology and Immunology of Porto University, Porto, Portugal.
papers.authors_conclusion: 通过将形态学评估与辅助检测相结合，细胞病理学家可实现准确的肿瘤亚型判定、区分类似病变，并提供可指导临床管理与靶向治疗选择的精准诊断。
papers.ai_note: 全文为叙述性综述，摘要未给出检索策略、纳入文献数量、任何诊断准确性数值（敏感度/特异度/一致率）或验证数据，故“可实现准确亚型判定”属作者主张而非本研究证据；亦未说明对小活检/细胞学取材量受限时分子检测保留的具体阈值，信息不足。
papers.abstract_en: Accurate classification of lung tumors in cytology specimens and small biopsies remains a diagnostic challenge because of limited cellularity, preanalytical variables, and significant morphologic overlap among entities. This review summarizes key cytomorphologic characteristics and practical immunocytochemical strategies, and common diagnostic pitfalls encountered in the evaluation of non-small cell lung carcinoma, small cell lung carcinoma, neuroendocrine tumors, secondary pulmonary neoplasms, and uncommon thoracic entities in endobronchial ultrasound-guided transbronchial needle aspiration and fine-needle aspiration samples. Particular emphasis is placed on the appropriate use of limited immunohistochemical panels to optimize tumor subtyping while preserving material for molecular testing. Diagnostic challenges such as crush artifact, necrosis, reactive mimics, overlapping morphologic patterns, and the risk of misclassification of rare tumors are addressed with practical guidance for differential diagnosis. By integrating morphologic assessment with ancillary testing, cytopathologists can achieve accurate tumor subtyping, distinguish mimics, and provide precise diagnoses that guide clinical management and selection of targeted therapies.

papers.study_type: 研究类型待评定（启发式模式）
papers.title_zh: Rab7a promotes the progression of esophageal squamous cell carcinoma via the Hippo signaling pathway.
papers.title_en: Rab7a promotes the progression of esophageal squamous cell carcinoma via the Hippo signaling pathway.
papers.authors: Liu B, Tian Y, Lv Y
papers.affiliation_highlight: Department of Pathology, First Affiliated Hospital of Hebei North University, Zhangjiakou, Hebei, China.
papers.abstract_en: Ras-related protein Rab7a participates in fundamental cancer cell processes; however, its role in esophageal squamous cell carcinoma (ESCC) remains unclear. In this study, we aimed to define Rab7a's oncogenic functions in ESCC and its involvement in the Hippo signaling pathway. Rab7a expression was assessed using ESCC datasets and validated by immunohistochemical analysis of ESCC tissues. We examined functional effects using small interfering RNA knockdown and Yes-associated protein 1 (YAP1) overexpression rescue experiments, primarily by evaluating proliferation, migration, invasion, and apoptosis in ESCC TE-1 cells. We also established a xenograft model for in vivo validation. Regarding its mechanism(s) of action, we analyzed the effects of Rab7a on Hippo core kinases (LATS1/2 and MOB1) and further assessed YAP nuclear localization in ESCC cells. Rab7a was overexpressed in ESCC tissues, and elevated expression correlated with aggressive clinicopathological features, including advanced tumor, node, metastasis stage, positive lymph node metastasis, deep tumor invasion, and poor differentiation. Rab7a knockdown suppressed cellular proliferation, migration, and invasion and induced apoptosis in vitro while inhibiting tumor growth and decreasing Ki-67 expression in vivo. Mechanistically, Rab7a silencing downregulated YAP1, p-YAP1, CTGF, and survivin without affecting MST1. Furthermore, Rab7a knockdown significantly increased p-LATS1/2 levels without altering total LATS1/2 or MOB1 expression and decreased YAP nuclear accumulation. Importantly, YAP1 overexpression effectively reversed the suppressive effects of Rab7a knockdown on malignant phenotypes at both the functional and molecular levels, and restored the expression of downstream targets. Rab7a depletion also reversed an epithelial-mesenchymal transition (EMT)-like phenotype, as evidenced by upregulated E-cadherin and downregulated vimentin and Snail. This effect was rescued by YAP1 overexpression. Our findings demonstrate that Rab7a promotes ESCC progression by regulating the Hippo pathway effector YAP, thus inducing an EMT-like phenotype. Rab7a may serve as a promising prognostic biomarker and therapeutic target in ESCC that functions upstream of LATS1/2 to modulate YAP-mediated tumor progression.

papers.title_zh: Quantitative systems pharmacology modeling of class I-III BRAF-mutant NSCLC enables subgroup treatment analysis and combination therapy design.
papers.title_en: Quantitative systems pharmacology modeling of class I-III BRAF-mutant NSCLC enables subgroup treatment analysis and combination therapy design.
papers.authors: Hu J, Rao Q, Li Z, Li G, Bi Z, Wen D, Zhao C, Zhou G et al.
papers.affiliation_highlight: Department of Clinical Pharmacy, Jinling Hospital, Affiliated Hospital of Medical School, Nanjing University, Nanjing, C…
papers.abstract_en: BRAF-mutant non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC) comprises three functional classes (I-III) with distinct driving mechanisms, yet effective therapies for classes II and III remain limited. To address this, we developed a quantitative systems pharmacology (QSP) model that mechanistically recapitulates signaling networks and drug responses across all three classes, integrating multiscale preclinical-to-clinical datasets. The model enabled high-throughput prediction of clinical efficacy for monotherapies and combination therapies across diverse dosing regimens, and we identified that combining MEK and ERK inhibition represents a novel strategy for class II/III mutants, validated by original in vivo MiniPDX data using NSCLC patient tumors. Simulations further revealed that only triple blockade of EGFR, IGF1R, and FGFR pathway initiation can potently reduce tumor growth and overcome resistance in these classes. Our work is the first multiscale QSP platform mechanistically addressing class I-III BRAF mutations at the systems level for disease-centric translational combination therapy discovery and precision medicine design.

papers.title_zh: Association Between Electronic Health Record Health Maintenance Topic and Lung Cancer Screening Completion in a Resident-Run Clinic.
papers.title_en: Association Between Electronic Health Record Health Maintenance Topic and Lung Cancer Screening Completion in a Resident-Run Clinic.
papers.authors: Stawkowski LJ, Davenport C, Zaffiri K, Slenker A
papers.affiliation_highlight: Internal Medicine, Lehigh Valley Health Network, Allentown, USA.
papers.abstract_en: INTRODUCTION: Lung cancer screening (LCS) with low-dose computed tomography (LDCT) reduces lung cancer-specific mortality in high-risk populations, yet screening rates remain low nationwide. Electronic health record (EHR) health maintenance tracking may support guideline-concordant screening, but implementation varies across outpatient settings. OBJECTIVE: To evaluate the association between manually adding the LCS health maintenance topic in the EHR and completion of LDCT screening in a resident-run outpatient clinic. METHODS: This retrospective cross-sectional study evaluated adult patients at a resident-run Federally Qualified Health Center Look-Alike clinic who met age and smoking history criteria for LCS in October 2024. Patients were categorized based on whether the LCS health maintenance topic was manually added within the Epic EHR and whether LDCT screening had been completed. Screening completion rates were compared using a chi-square test. RESULTS: Among 305 eligible patients, 130 (43%) completed LDCT screening. Of screened patients, 96 (74%) had the LCS health maintenance topic added, compared with 86 (49%) of 175 (57%) unscreened patients. Adding the LCS health maintenance topic was significantly associated with LDCT screening completion (p<0.001). CONCLUSION: Having the LCS health maintenance topic activated in the EHR was associated with higher rates of LDCT screening completion in a resident-run clinic compared with not having the LCS health maintenance topic activated. These findings support the role of having the LCS health maintenance topic added in the EHR as a practical strategy to reinforce preventive care delivery in outpatient practice.

papers.title_zh: Dissection of intratumor microbiome-host interactions at the single-cell level in lung cancer.
papers.title_en: Dissection of intratumor microbiome-host interactions at the single-cell level in lung cancer.
papers.authors: Ma YJ, Sun YC, Wang L, Xu WX, Fan XD, Ding J, Heeschen C, Wu WJ et al.
papers.affiliation_highlight: State Key Laboratory of Systems Medicine for Cancer, Center for Single-Cell Omics, School of Public Health, Shanghai Jia…
papers.abstract_en: The intratumor microbiome, one of the hallmarks of cancer, plays a crucial role in cancer progression through its interaction with the host. However, the underlying mechanisms remain poorly understood. In this study, six publicly available single-cell transcriptomic lung cancer datasets (comprising 178 samples) from multiple centers (Shanghai, New York, Seoul) were integrated to investigate the heterogeneity of host-microbiome interactions at the single-cell level using single-cell analysis of host-microbiome interactions (SAHMI). The results indicate that primary tumor tissues have a high proportion of fungi-associated cells, whereas metastatic brain tissues predominantly contain bacteria-associated cells. There are also distinct microbial distributions across cell types. Notably, the presence of specific bacteria significantly influences the transcriptome of resident host cells, including T cells and macrophages, by modulating pathways related to ribosomal RNA (rRNA) processing, cellular responses to stress and stimuli, and RNA and protein metabolism. Finally, specific cell-associated bacteria are significantly correlated with clinical features, such as lung cancer stages and smoking frequency. These single-cell insights into microbiome-host interactions improve current understanding about lung cancer development and progression and offer potential micro-ecological and diagnostic insights.

papers.study_type: 研究类型待评定（启发式模式）
papers.title_zh: HSV-Net: hybrid state-space and self-supervised vision fusion with progressive contour learning for CT pulmonary nodule segmentation.
papers.title_en: HSV-Net: hybrid state-space and self-supervised vision fusion with progressive contour learning for CT pulmonary nodule segmentation.
papers.authors: Cheng L, Wan X
papers.affiliation_highlight: Dexing People's Hospital, Dexing, Jiangxi, China.
papers.abstract_en: Accurate voxel-level segmentation of pulmonary nodules on chest CT is needed for diameter and volume measurement, growth tracking, and quantitative assessment in lung cancer screening. The task remains difficult: nodules vary in attenuation, size, and contact with vessels or pleura, and clinically relevant morphology often lies in a thin, ambiguous margin. Existing systems commonly trade contour fidelity for speed-large prompt-driven foundation models can be accurate but slow, whereas compact CNN or SSM decoders are efficient yet tend to smooth spiculated and ground-glass borders. We propose HSV-Net (Hybrid State-space-Vision Network), a dual-stream 3D network that is prompt-free after nodule localization: an SSM3D stream provides whole-patch context with linear-complexity state-space blocks, and an OrthoLoRA stream adapts frozen DINOv2 features on axial, coronal, and sagittal slices. A Hybrid Gated Mixer (HGM) fuses the two streams before FPN decoding, and Progressive Contour Learning (PCL) supervises overlap, signed-distance-field geometry, and uncertainty-weighted contour refinement. On a 10-patient QIN Lung CT/QIN-LungCT-Seg development subset (n = 12 tumors; nested patient-level 5-fold CV), HSV-Net obtained the highest mean Dice (90.1% ± 1.0%; 95% CI [88.9, 91.3]) and Boundary F1 (86.3% ± 1.3%) among the compared methods on 128 × 128 × 64 patches, with a latency of 58 ms. A standard full-volume nnU-Net v2 baseline reached 88.6% ± 1.0% Dice on the same QIN folds, still below HSV-Net. On an independent LIDC-IDRI benchmark with expert volumetric consensus masks (186 patients/294 nodules; patient-level 5-fold CV within LIDC, not QIN→LIDC transfer), HSV-Net achieved 87.8% ± 1.1% Dice and 83.6% ± 1.3% Boundary F1, outperforming full-volume nnU-Net (87.1% ± 1.0% Dice). LUNA16 was retained only as a proxy size/localization check with diameter-matched spherical references, not as contour external validation.

papers.study_type: 研究类型待评定（启发式模式）
papers.title_zh: Immune-related adverse events are associated with favorable clinical outcomes in esophageal cancer treated with immune checkpoint inhibitors: a systematic review and meta-analysis.
papers.title_en: Immune-related adverse events are associated with favorable clinical outcomes in esophageal cancer treated with immune checkpoint inhibitors: a systematic review and meta-analysis.
papers.authors: Fan J, Chen D, Jia L
papers.affiliation_highlight: Graduate School, Beijing University of Chinese Medicine, Beijing, China.
papers.abstract_en: INTRODUCTION: Immune-related adverse events (irAEs) are distinctive toxicities associated with immune checkpoint inhibitors (ICIs) and have been reported to correlate with clinical outcomes in several cancers. However, whether this association also exists in patients with esophageal cancer (EC) receiving ICIs remains uncertain. This systematic review and meta-analysis aimed to evaluate the association between irAEs and clinical outcomes in this population. METHODS: This systematic review and meta-analysis was conducted and reported in accordance with the Preferred Reporting Items for Systematic Reviews and Meta-Analyses (PRISMA) 2020 statement. PubMed, Embase, Web of Science, and the Cochrane Library were searched from inception to March 2, 2026. Eligible studies evaluated the association between irAEs and progression-free survival (PFS), overall survival (OS), objective response rate (ORR), or disease control rate (DCR). Hazard ratios (HRs) with 95% confidence intervals (CIs) were pooled for PFS and OS, whereas odds ratios (ORs) with 95% CIs were pooled for ORR and DCR using random-effects models. Between-study heterogeneity, 95% prediction intervals (PIs), sensitivity analyses, publication bias, prespecified subgroup analyses, and immortal-time bias were also assessed. RESULTS: 14 studies involving 1, 546 patients were included. The occurrence of irAEs was associated with improved PFS (HR, 0.45; 95% CI, 0.31-0.63), OS (HR, 0.54; 95% CI, 0.46-0.64), ORR (OR, 4.00; 95% CI, 1.58-10.12), and DCR (OR, 3.85; 95% CI, 2.40-6.20). The 95% PIs were 0.16-1.24, 0.44-0.66, 0.19-82.57, and 1.42-10.44 for PFS, OS, ORR, and DCR, respectively, crossing the null value for PFS and ORR. Subgroup estimates were generally similar in direction but remained exploratory. No eligible survival estimates using landmark or time-varying approaches were available for the comparison between patients with and without irAEs. CONCLUSIONS: In patients with EC receiving ICIs, the occurrence of irAEs may be a prognostic marker of favorable outcomes. However, wide PIs for PFS and ORR indicate that these associations may vary across future studies and immortal time bias may overestimate survival associations. This observational evidence derives mainly from East Asian patients with esophageal squamous cell carcinoma and is primarily applicable to these patients. Subgroup findings remain exploratory and require prospective validation. SYSTEMATIC REVIEW REGISTRATION: https://www.crd.york.ac.uk/prospero/, identifier CRD420261346294.

papers.study_type: 病例报告（单例）· 晚期肺浸润性黏液腺癌治疗中的影像反应评估
papers.category_label: 局晚期与晚期靶向/免疫
papers.title_zh: 晚期浸润性黏液腺癌治疗后多灶空洞化致影像反应评估矛盾：一例病例报告
papers.title_en: Discordant Cavitary Changes: A Radiological Dilemma in Invasive Mucinous Adenocarcinoma: A Case Report.
papers.authors: Nigi A, Miya N, Iwamoto K, Itani H, Kondou S
papers.affiliation_highlight: Department of Respiratory Medicine Japanese Red Cross Ise Hospital Ise Mie Japan.
papers.authors_conclusion: This case illustrates that marked multifocal cavitary transformation may produce discordant morphological changes, limiting response assessment based on imaging alone.
papers.ai_note: 单例病例报告，无对照；将空洞化归因于治疗相关缺乏病理或时序对照支持；影像反应评估基于主观CT描述，未提供测量值或RECIST细节；肿瘤标志物正常与疾病进展并存，提示不能依赖标志物判断；结论外推受限。
papers.abstract_en: Treatment-related cavitary transformation in lung cancer may complicate radiological response assessment. We report a man in his 70s with stage IVA invasive mucinous adenocarcinoma treated with atezolizumab, bevacizumab, carboplatin and paclitaxel. After two cycles, CT showed enlargement of cavitary components despite regression of solid tumour components, making response assessment difficult. After two additional cycles, the pulmonary lesions showed little change, whereas progression of the Th4 bone metastasis led to an overall assessment of progressive disease and a change to docetaxel plus ramucirumab. Thereafter, the cavities further enlarged while the cavity walls progressively thinned and the solid components appeared to regress. This case illustrates that marked multifocal cavitary transformation may produce discordant morphological changes, limiting response assessment based on imaging alone. Serum CEA and SLX levels remained within the normal ranges at diagnosis and throughout treatment.

papers.study_type: 叙述性综述/专家意见（非系统综述，无原始数据）
papers.category_label: 局晚期与晚期靶向/免疫
papers.title_zh: 广泛期小细胞肺癌药物治疗前景：免疫联合、Tarlatamab与ADC的叙述性综述
papers.title_en: Extensive-stage small-cell lung cancer pharmacotherapy: what is on the horizon?
papers.authors: Maione P, Palma V, Pucillo G, Gridelli C
papers.affiliation_highlight: Division of Medical Oncology, S.G.
papers.authors_conclusion: As never in the past, the prognosis of ES-SCLC patients seems characterized by a new light, with innovative drugs that used combined or sequentially, have the potential of a substantial change of the natural history of this aggressive disease.
papers.ai_note: 叙述性专家意见，无系统检索、偏倚评估或原始效应量，摘要未报告任何数值；将lurbinectedin联合atezolizumab一线维持和tarlatamab二线称为已建立两个新标准，但未呈现关键终点数据与证据强度；对ifinitamab deruxtecan、sacituzumab govitecan使用“very promising”属乐观表述；主要终点与样本量信息不足。
papers.abstract_en: INTRODUCTION: Extensive-stage small cell lung cancer (ES-SCLC) is yet to be considered an oncologic clinical condition characterized by a dismal prognosis. However, about 5 years ago, the introduction of immunotherapy in the first-line regimens, combined with platin-based chemotherapy, has produced an improvement of survival outcomes for this patient population. AREAS COVERED: In the last year, two innovative approaches have further improved efficacy outcomes for ES-SCLC patients. The addition of lurbinectedin to the immunotherapeutic drug atezolizumab in the maintenance phase of first-line treatment, and the introduction of the bispecific T-cell engager antibody tarlatamab as second-line treatment, have established two new standards of care for the treatment of ES-SCLC. Moreover, ongoing phase III trials are testing the possibility to introduce tarlatamab in the first-line setting, as induction or as maintenance. Simultaneosusly, phase II trials have reported very promising antitumor activity for ifinitamab deruxtecan and sacituzumab govitecan, two antibody drug conjugates in the second-line setting, and phase III trials are ongoing. EXPERT OPINION: As never in the past, the prognosis of ES-SCLC patients seems characterized by a new light, with innovative drugs that used combined or sequentially, have the potential of a substantial change of the natural history of this aggressive disease.

papers.title_zh: 留置引流系统中胸腔组织碎屑用于恶性胸腔积液病理诊断与分子分型的2例病例报告
papers.title_en: Case Report: Diagnostic utility of pleural tissue debris retrieved during percutaneous drainage for the diagnosis of malignant pleural effusion and molecular profiling.
papers.authors: Kim J, Kim HG, Lee SH
papers.affiliation_highlight: Division of Pulmonary, Allergy, and Critical Care Medicine, Department of Internal Medicine, Kyung Hee University Hospit…
papers.authors_conclusion: 据作者所知，这是首篇描述胸腔组织碎屑用于恶性胸腔积液诊断及其分子检测适用性的病例报告；该报告提示，这一既往被忽视的常规胸腔引流副产物可为恶性胸腔积液患者（尤其是存在常规活检禁忌或拒绝活检者）提供足以完成组织病理诊断、免疫组化与分子检测的材料
papers.ai_note: 仅2例成功案例，存在明显的发表偏倚（只报告取材成功者），无法估计组织碎屑的可获得率、细胞量不足率与诊断失败率；无标准活检或胸腔细胞学对照，未验证诊断一致性；“组织碎屑偶然发现”说明取材非预设流程，可重复性未知；病例2的脑部病灶未述及病理确认；标题称经皮引流而正文表述为导管/胸腔引流管，术语略不一致；由2例即外推至“恶性胸腔积液患者”整体，人群限定过宽；摘要无随访与治疗反应数据
papers.abstract_en: BACKGROUND: Although pleural tissue debris is occasionally encountered in the drainage systems of patients undergoing catheter or chest tube drainage, its clinical utility has not been reported. Here, we report two cases in which pleural tissue debris retrieved during catheter drainage enabled a definitive diagnosis of malignant pleural effusion (MPE) and molecularly guided treatment decisions. CASE PRESENTATION: The first case involved a 67-year-old woman with rheumatoid arthritis-associated interstitial lung disease who developed a right pleural effusion suggestive of lung cancer with pleural metastasis. Invasive procedures for tissue acquisition were required; however, biopsy was withheld because of the high risk of pneumothorax and acute exacerbation of the underlying lung disease. Tissue debris was incidentally found in the drainage system. The tissue was adequate for pathological examination and revealed lung squamous cell carcinoma without genomic alterations. Chemoimmunotherapy was initiated without further invasive procedures. The second case involved a 78-year-old woman who presented with a left pleural effusion and a brain lesion, highly suggestive of lung cancer with brain metastasis. She declined invasive diagnostic procedures; however, tissue debris was incidentally collected from the drainage bottle and diagnosed as lung adenocarcinoma. Molecular testing revealed that the tumor harbored an epidermal growth factor receptor (EGFR) L858R mutation, allowing first-line targeted therapy to be initiated without further invasive testing. CONCLUSION: To the best of our knowledge, this is the first case report to describe the clinical utility of pleural tissue debris for the diagnosis of MPE and its suitability for molecular profiling. Our report highlights that this previously overlooked byproduct of routine pleural drainage can provide adequate material for histopathological diagnosis, immunohistochemistry, and molecular testing in patients with MPE, particularly those for whom conventional biopsy is contraindicated or declined.
