papers.title_en: Co-targeting PARP and SHP2 Overcomes Resistance to Apoptosis and Induces Durable Responses in Breast Cancer.
papers.authors: Luna A, Wang H, Wang L, Dereli Z, Jeong KJ, Yan G, Awasthi S, Zhang D et al.
papers.affiliation_highlight: United States National Library of Medicine Bethesda, MD United States.
papers.authors_conclusion: This study demonstrates that TargetScore may advance precision oncology by matching drug combinations to molecular signatures and dependencies revealed under therapeutic stress（并称联合靶向 lays the groundwork for clinical evaluation）
papers.ai_note: 信息不足：摘要通篇无任何定量数据（无样本量、肿瘤消退比例、OS的HR/CI/P），仅以'near-complete tumor eradication''significant survival benefit'等定性措辞表述主要疗效，无法核验；未说明比较组（单药或载体对照）及耐药模型细节。TargetScore的预测能力仅在同一数据集内验证，摘要未提独立/外部验证队列，存在方法学自证风险。研究对象为乳腺癌，与胸部肿瘤业务关联有限，转化至患者尚无临床证据。
papers.abstract_en: Resistance to therapeutic interventions contributes to poor long-term cancer patient outcomes. Adaptation to therapy, a common mechanism of drug resistance involving drug-induced activation of pro-survival oncogenic processes, poses a challenge for the implementation of effective precision therapies. Here, we addressed this challenge using the TargetScore network modeling method to nominate combination therapies that block adaptive responses in breast cancer. TargetScore identified therapeutically actionable adaptive responses as drug-induced concurrent changes in phospho-proteins connected within a signaling network. To study how apoptotic stress rewires cancer cells and uncover therapeutically actionable oncogenic dependencies, breast cancer cells were perturbed with inhibitors of anti-apoptotic mediators, particularly MCL1. TargetScore and phosphoproteomics analyses revealed the short-term (i.e., days) stress and long-term (i.e., months) acquired drug resistance to inhibitors of anti-apoptotic mediators. TargetScore predicted concurrent activation of growth and DNA repair pathways as cells evolved to resist apoptotic targeting. Validation of the predictions demonstrated strong responses to PARP1/2 and SHP2 inhibitor combination in vitro and in vivo. In genetically engineered mouse models, PARP1/2 and SHP2 co-targeting led to near-complete tumor eradication and durable responses with significant survival benefit, laying the groundwork for clinical evaluation. Functional proteomics and perturbation biology analyses proposed a mechanism of response to PARP1/2 and SHP2 co-targeting associated with molecular markers of DNA damage response, replication stress, and cell cycle arrest. This study demonstrates that TargetScore may advance precision oncology by matching drug combinations to molecular signatures and dependencies revealed under therapeutic stress.

papers.study_type: 研究类型待评定（启发式模式）
papers.title_zh: Non-invasive quantification of lower airway antigen-specific antibodies using exhaled breath particles - an observational proof-of-concept study.
papers.title_en: Non-invasive quantification of lower airway antigen-specific antibodies using exhaled breath particles - an observational proof-of-concept study.
papers.authors: Aguilera K, Hober A, Norin NG, Mahdi M, Stäheli VC, Kolosenko I, Lindberg P, Larsson E et al.
papers.affiliation_highlight: Department of Clinical Sciences, Danderyd Hospital, Karolinska Institutet, Stockholm, Sweden.
papers.abstract_en: BACKGROUND: Advancements in mucosal vaccine development highlight the urgent need for practical methods to assess immune responses in both upper and lower airways. Although nasal sampling is increasingly standardised, a non-invasive technique for directly assessing antigen-specific antibodies in the distal airways has been lacking. METHODS: We used Particles in Exhaled Air (PExA), a non-invasive method capturing aerosolised respiratory tract lining fluid (RTLF) from the distal airways, to quantify antigen-specific IgA and IgG. Antibodies were measured in paired serum, nasal secretions, and PExA samples from 28 healthcare workers during spring 2025, including 18 with RT-qPCR-confirmed SARS-CoV-2, influenza A (H1N1), or respiratory syncytial virus (RSV) infection. FINDINGS: Antigen-specific IgA and IgG measurements in PExA samples showed low variability (median CVs: spike-IgA 3.7%, H1-IgA 7.2%, RSV pre-F-IgA 5.3%). Strong correlations (Spearman's rho >0.85, p < 0.0001) were observed between PExA and serum IgG, which may be consistent with a systemic contribution to lower-airway IgG levels. In contrast, IgA correlations were more modest, which may reflect local IgA production in the lungs. IgG and IgA correlated between PExA and nasal secretions, while the IgA/IgG ratio was higher in nasal secretions (median 5.0 vs 0.6, p < 0.0001), consistent with expected isotype distribution in upper and lower airways. INTERPRETATION: This study demonstrates the feasibility of non-invasive measurement of antigen-specific antibodies in the lower airways. Our approach proposes a framework for assessing lower-airway immunity and supporting next-generation mucosal vaccine development. FUNDING: This study was funded by the European Research Council, the Swedish Society for Medical Research, and the Knut and Alice Wallenberg Foundation.

papers.title_zh: Subunit engineering enables the generation of human interleukin-39 as a proinflammatory cytokine.
papers.title_en: Subunit engineering enables the generation of human interleukin-39 as a proinflammatory cytokine.
papers.authors: Bergmann CJ, Ambrosius CK, Hadzic A, Kerle A, Held J, Weidenspointner RJ, Haft N, Hildenbrand K et al.
papers.affiliation_highlight: Center for Functional Protein Assemblies (CPA), Department of Bioscience, TUM School of Natural Sciences, Technical Univ…
papers.abstract_en: Interleukins are signaling proteins that control immune responses. Defining the range of human interleukins, their associated receptors, signaling pathways, and functions is thus indispensable for understanding and modulating protective and pathological immunity. Interleukin-39 (IL-39), a heterodimer composed of the subunits IL-23α and EBI3, has been described as a proinflammatory cytokine in mice, but its existence in the human interleukin repertoire has remained controversial. Here, we showed that IL-39 did not readily form from IL-23α and EBI3 in human cells. A combined computer modeling and experimental approach identified structural features that destabilize the human IL-23α:EBI3 heterodimer. Using these insights, we rationally engineered human IL-23α and EBI3 to form disulfide-linked heterodimers that were secreted by cells. This engineered cytokine engaged the receptor subunits IL-23R and gp130 on primary human immune cells to stimulate phosphorylation of the transcriptional regulators STAT1 and STAT3, resulting in proinflammatory cytokine secretion. Together, our findings define limitations in the biogenesis of human IL-39 and show that these can be overcome by molecular engineering. This work highlights the potential of rational cytokine engineering for generating active immune signaling proteins and lays the foundation for further defining possible roles of IL-39 in human immunity.

papers.study_type: ATLANTIS研究基线数据的事后分析（横断面表型比较，含CT与鼻腔转录组亚组）
papers.title_zh: 振荡法支气管舒张试验在肺功能正常舒张反应者之外额外识别出11%的应答者，并对应不同炎症、生理与气道结构表型：ATLANTIS研究事后分析
papers.title_en: Oscillometry bronchodilator response testing identifies distinct pathophysiological phenotypes: a post hoc analysis of the ATLANTIS study.
papers.authors: Quek E, Pitts O, Clemeno FA, Kocks JWH, Beghe B, Kraft M, Argentina US, Papi A et al.
papers.affiliation_highlight: National Heart and Lung Institute, NIHR Imperial Biomedical Research Centre, Imperial College London, London, UK.
papers.authors_conclusion: Oscillometry identified additional bronchodilator-responsive participants beyond spirometry, indicating complementary physiological information. Distinct BDR patterns were associated with differing inflammatory, physiological and structural features, suggesting distinct asthma phenotypes.
papers.ai_note: 信息不足：未给出以哮喘诊断金标准为参照的振荡法敏感度/特异度，'额外11%'仅为检出重叠差异，不能推断诊断效能提升；所有表型差异均为横断面关联，无临床结局或治疗反应验证；组间比较仅报告p<0.05，未见多重比较校正、效应量与CI，属事后亚组分析；CT（208/518）与转录组（236/518）亚组存在选择性纳入风险；摘要未设主要/次要终点层级
papers.abstract_en: BACKGROUND: Spirometry with bronchodilator response (BDR) testing is the first-line test for asthma in international guidelines; however, it has been shown to have suboptimal sensitivity for asthma diagnosis and detecting small airways dysfunction. Oscillometry with BDR may identify bronchodilator response in patients with no significant BDR by spirometry. The aims of the present study were to determine whether oscillometry identifies additional BDR in the Assessment of Small Airways Involvement in Asthma (ATLANTIS) study asthma cohort compared to spirometry (ClinicalTrials.gov identifier NCT02123667), and to characterise phenotypic differences between BDR groups. METHODS: Baseline data from 518 adults with objectively confirmed asthma enrolled in ATLANTIS were analysed. Differences in clinical, biomarker and physiological characteristics were assessed between BDR groups. A subset with computed tomography (CT) imaging (208 out of 518) and nasal RNA-sequencing data (236 out of 518) underwent CT biomarker and differential gene expression analysis to investigate differences in airway morphology and pathways underlying a small airways bronchodilator responsive phenotype. RESULTS: Oscillometry detected significant bronchodilator response in an additional 11% of participants not identified by spirometry, although spirometry identified more responders overall. Spirometry-positive BDR-only cases (group 1) had greater airway obstruction and exhaled nitric oxide fraction (p<0.05) compared with oscillometry-only BDR (group 2). Subgroup analysis identified differentially expressed genes related to mitochondrial stress and cell adhesion in group 3 (BDR in both) versus group 1 and reduced luminal area and greater gas trapping on CT imaging (p<0.05). INTERPRETATION: Oscillometry identified additional bronchodilator-responsive participants beyond spirometry, indicating complementary physiological information. Distinct BDR patterns were associated with differing inflammatory, physiological and structural features, suggesting distinct asthma phenotypes.

papers.study_type: 实验方法学研究 · 新建纳米孔tRIBO-seq技术并在多种细胞应激模型中验证应用
papers.category_label: 局晚期与晚期靶向/免疫
papers.title_zh: 开发基于纳米孔的tRIBO-seq方法选择性捕获核糖体活性tRNA，并揭示不同类型应激下tRNA丰度、修饰与片段化的差异动态
papers.title_en: Selective profiling of translationally active tRNAs and their dynamics under stress.
papers.authors: Monti M, Yilmaz H, Del Piano A, Arnoldi M, Bonomo I, Llovera L, Sarabando J, Ribeiro D et al.
papers.affiliation_highlight: Centre for Genomic Regulation (CRG), The Barcelona Institute of Science and Technology, Barcelona, Spain.
papers.authors_conclusion: tRIBO-seq offers a robust and reproducible approach to map the full tRNA landscape-capturing tRNA abundance, modification and fragmentation patterns-across both total and actively translating tRNA populations, revealing the dynamics of the tRNAome with unprecedented resolution, in a single experiment
papers.ai_note: 纯方法学论文，无临床终点与患者数据；摘要未提供任何定量性能指标（如与Northern blot/质谱的一致性、检出限、重复性数值）、样本量与统计检验信息，信息不足，无法评估方法准确性；'robust and reproducible''unprecedented resolution'等为作者自评，缺乏摘要内数据支撑；应激模型为体外细胞实验，向肿瘤组织或临床样本的外推未经验证
papers.abstract_en: During translation, transfer RNAs (tRNAs) deliver specific amino acids to the ribosome in a coordinated manner with the sequence encoded by the messenger RNA. Despite their central role in protein synthesis, their precise contribution to the modulation of translation remains poorly understood, primarily due to lack of methods to characterize tRNA abundances and their modifications from actively translating ribosomes. Here we develop tRIBO-seq, a simple and robust nanopore-based method to selectively capture ribosome-associated native tRNA populations (ribo-tRNAs) from actively translating ribosomes, providing tRNA abundance, modification and fragmentation information from a single experiment. Using tRIBO-seq, we find that ribo-tRNAs, but often not total tRNAs, are significantly altered on stress. Notably, we find that tRNAome alterations strongly vary depending on the stress type; while viral infection and leucine deprivation leads to changes in ribo-tRNA abundances, methionine starvation causes a dramatic loss of methyl-based tRNA modifications. By contrast, we find that arsenite exposure does not alter tRNA abundances nor modification patterns, but rather causes major fragmentation events in selected subsets of ribo-tRNAs. Altogether, tRIBO-seq offers a robust and reproducible approach to map the full tRNA landscape-capturing tRNA abundance, modification and fragmentation patterns-across both total and actively translating tRNA populations, revealing the dynamics of the tRNAome with unprecedented resolution, in a single experiment.

papers.study_type: 前瞻性诊断准确性研究（单臂，预设阈值，复合参考标准）
papers.title_zh: 基于LC-WGS染色体不稳定性分析对EUS-FNA标本诊断不确定实性胰腺病变的挽救性诊断价值
papers.title_en: LC-WGS-based Chromosomal Instability Analysis of EUS-FNA Specimens for Diagnosing Solid Pancreatic Lesions.
papers.authors: Zhou J, Sun J, Liu Y, Gong X, Zhu S
papers.affiliation_highlight: Department of General Surgery, Xiangya Hospital, Central South University, Changsha, Hunan, China.
papers.authors_conclusion: 基于LC-WGS的CIN分析可为EUS-FNA病理未定论的实性胰腺病变提供互补的分子信息
papers.ai_note: 样本量小（n=51），挽救组仅12例，效能估计不稳定；阴性预测值偏低（63.2%），作为排除性工具价值有限；未设独立验证队列；复合参考标准可能引入验证偏倚；将挽救组与对照组合并计算总体效能可能高估真实表现；研究对象为胰腺病变，与胸科业务关联有限
papers.abstract_en: BACKGROUND: Endoscopic ultrasound-guided fine-needle aspiration (EUS-FNA) is widely used to obtain tissue for the diagnosis of solid pancreatic lesions, but indeterminate or inconclusive pathology remains challenging. This study evaluated low-coverage whole-genome sequencing (LC-WGS)-based chromosomal instability (CIN) analysis as a salvage diagnostic strategy for EUS-FNA specimens. METHODS: Patients with solid pancreatic lesions undergoing EUS-FNA were prospectively enrolled. Genomic DNA from FNA specimens was analyzed by LC-WGS, and CIN results were classified as positive or negative using a prespecified threshold. Diagnostic performance was assessed against a composite reference standard. RESULTS: The analysis included 51 patients. Conventional pathology showed a sensitivity of 55.3% and an accuracy of 66.7%. The patients were classified into three groups: Salvage, defined as indeterminate, suspicious, or nondiagnostic initial pathology (n = 12); Malignant Control, defined as final malignant diagnosis with conclusive initial pathology (n = 26); and Benign Control, defined as final benign diagnosis with benign initial pathology (n = 13). The CIN analysis achieved a sensitivity of 81.6%, a specificity of 92.3%, an accuracy of 84.3%, a positive predictive value of 96.9%, and a negative predictive value of 63.2%. In the Salvage group, CIN correctly identified malignancy in 9 of 12 unresolved cases. Combining CIN with pathology increased sensitivity to 86.8% and accuracy to 88.2%. CONCLUSION: An LC-WGS-based CIN analysis may provide complementary molecular information for solid pancreatic lesions with nondefinitive EUS-FNA pathology.

papers.study_type: NHANES 2015-2018 横断面观察性研究 · 探索性中介分析与机器学习分类

papers.authors: Liu J, Hu T

papers.ai_note: ①横断面自报结局（医生诊断慢性支气管炎史）无法推断因果，DI-GM由膳食回忆推断而非直接测序菌群，暴露与结局均依赖报告，存在回忆/报告偏倚；②摘要突出显著的DI-GM与BGMS，但UGMS（不利子评分）无任何数值报告，疑似选择性呈现；③样条提示'非线性'却未给出拐点或分段OR，无法判断临床阈值；④中介分析仅为探索性且自述未确立因果，仍与主要结果并列展示，易被误读为机制证据；⑤机器学习AUC 0.669-0.742属中低区分度，且系事后衍生分析，摘要末句与主要关联结论混排，信息不足（未说明训练/验证划分与校准）；⑥未见混杂（吸烟、BMI、社会经济）调整详情，信息不足。
papers.abstract_en: This study investigated the association between the dietary index for gut microbiota (DI-GM) and self-reported history of clinician-diagnosed chronic bronchitis (CB history) among 7,431 U.S. adults aged ≥ 20 years using data from the 2015-2018 National Health and Nutrition Examination Survey (NHANES). The DI-GM score was calculated utilizing dietary recall data, encompassing both beneficial (BGMS) and unfavorable (UGMS) to gut microbiota score. CB history was ascertained using the question: "Has a doctor or other health professional ever told you that you had chronic bronchitis?". Weighted multivariable logistic regression showed that higher DI-GM score and BGMS were associated with lower odds of CB history (DI-GM: odds ratio [OR] = 0.84, 95% CI: 0.76-0.94, P = 0.007; BGMS: OR = 0.84, 95% CI: 0.73-0.97, P = 0.019). Restricted cubic spline analyses indicated nonlinear relationships, and exploratory mediation analyses identified small indirect associations involving C-reactive protein (CRP) and systemic immune-inflammation index (SII), without establishing causal mediation. Machine-learning classification models yielded test-set areas under the receiver operating characteristic curve ranging from 0.669 to 0.742. Overall, higher DI-GM score was associated with lower odds of CB history, while the findings involving systemic inflammation and machine-learning classification warrant further validation.

papers.study_type: 回顾性单中心诊断性研究（免疫组化指标与综合参考标准的ROC分析）
papers.title_zh: EBUS-TBNA样本CD4/CD8免疫组化鉴别结节病与结核：仅中等诊断效能（CD4计数AUC 0.770），CD68无差异
papers.title_en: Diagnostic value of CD4, CD8 and CD68 immunohistochemical profiling in EBUS-TBNA samples for differentiating sarcoidosis and tuberculosis.
papers.authors: Özbolat ZB, Ortaköylü MG, Ürer HN, Uysal MA, Bağcı BA, Akalın ES, Parlar MA, İlhan U et al.
papers.affiliation_highlight: Department of Chest Diseases, Yedikule Chest Diseases and Thoracic Surgery Education and Research Hospital,, University …
papers.authors_conclusion: EBUS-TBNA样本中CD4+ T淋巴细胞谱及CD4/CD8比值的免疫组化评估可为结节病与结核的鉴别提供有意义的辅助信息；将免疫表型分析整合进常规病理评估或可提高肉芽肿性纵隔淋巴结病变患者的诊断准确性
papers.ai_note: 回顾性单中心、样本量小（85例），无外部验证或前瞻性验证；参考标准为临床-影像-微生物-随访综合判断，若其中包含组织病理结果则存在纳入偏倚；摘要仅报告AUC点估计，未给95%CI、最佳截断值、敏感度/特异度，也未报告与常规病理单独比较的增量价值，故‘提高诊断准确性’未被直接验证；CD68为阴性结果而结论未提；CD4/CD8比值组间p=0.004但AUC仅0.717，提示重叠明显、个体层面判别力有限；信息不足：各指标截断值与效能置信区间未提供
papers.abstract_en: BACKGROUND: Differentiating sarcoidosis from tuberculosis in patients with mediastinal and/or hilar granulomatous lymphadenopathy remains challenging due to overlapping clinical, radiological, and histopathological findings. Endobronchial ultrasound-guided transbronchial needle aspiration (EBUS-TBNA) allows minimally invasive sampling of lymph nodes; however, histopathological evaluation alone may be insufficient for accurate differentiation. This study aimed to investigate the diagnostic value of CD4 and CD8 T lymphocyte profiles and CD68 expression assessed by immunohistochemistry in EBUS-TBNA samples. METHODS: This retrospective single-center study included patients who underwent EBUS-TBNA for mediastinal and/or hilar lymphadenopathy between January and December 2019 and were diagnosed with granulomatous lymphadenitis. CD4 + and CD8 + T lymphocyte counts, percentages, CD4/CD8 ratios, and CD68 staining intensity were evaluated immunohistochemically in cell block specimens. Patients were classified as sarcoidosis or tuberculosis based on clinical, radiological, microbiological, and follow-up data. Diagnostic performance was assessed using receiver operating characteristic (ROC) analysis. RESULTS: Eighty-five patients were included (sarcoidosis: n = 55; tuberculosis: n = 30). CD4 + T lymphocyte count and percentage were significantly higher in the sarcoidosis group (p < 0.001 and p = 0.005, respectively). The CD4/CD8 ratio was also significantly elevated in sarcoidosis (median 1.44 vs. 0.35, p = 0.004). ROC analysis demonstrated moderate diagnostic performance for CD4 count (AUC 0.770), CD4% (AUC 0.686), and CD4/CD8 ratio (AUC 0.717). CD68 staining intensity did not differ significantly between groups. Granuloma necrosis was more frequent in tuberculosis (23.3% vs. 7.3%, p = 0.046). CONCLUSIONS: Immunohistochemical evaluation of CD4 + T lymphocyte profiles and CD4/CD8 ratio in EBUS-TBNA samples provides meaningful adjunctive information in differentiating sarcoidosis from tuberculosis. Integration of immunophenotypic analysis into routine pathological assessment may improve diagnostic accuracy in patients with granulomatous mediastinal lymphadenopathy.

papers.study_type: 全国多中心睡眠门诊观察性队列的横断面/关联性分析 · TURKAPNE数据库
papers.title_zh: 全国睡眠门诊队列中OSA合并失眠症状的患病构成、临床伴随症状与多导睡眠图特征（TURKAPNE，n=12,715）
papers.title_en: Clinical and Polysomnographic Characteristics of Comorbid Insomnia and Sleep Apnoea: Findings From the TURKAPNE Cohort.
papers.authors: Celik Y, Pihtili A, Kiyan E, Tasbakan MS, Basoglu ÖK, Aydin S, Cilli A, Dursunoglu N et al.
papers.affiliation_highlight: Koc University Research Center for Translational Medicine (KUTTAM), Istanbul, Türkiye.
papers.authors_conclusion: 在这一大型全国睡眠门诊队列中，OSA合并失眠症状常见，且与更高的临床复杂性以及呼吸与睡眠连续性双重紊乱相关。在接受评估的OSA患者中系统评估失眠症状，可能改善临床表征并支持更整合的管理方式。
papers.ai_note: 1）主要关联均以'参照组（既无OSA也无失眠）'为对照，摘要未报告临床上更关键的'OSA合并失眠 vs 仅OSA'直接比较，存在对照选择性；2）多项症状并行比较，摘要未说明多重比较校正，也未预设主要终点；3）失眠为问卷自报症状而非基于ICSD标准的临床诊断，人群界定松动；4）多变量回归的校正协变量在摘要中未说明，信息不足；5）25.8%为占全人群比例而非OSA患者中的比例，若按OSA人群计算约为25.8/(64.0+25.8)≈28.7%（摘要未直接给出，此为提示而非报告值）；6）横断面设计仅能提示关联，不能推断因果；7）睡眠专科人群，与胸外科/胸部肿瘤业务关联有限。
papers.abstract_en: Insomnia symptoms are frequently reported by patients with obstructive sleep apnoea (OSA). We aimed to estimate the prevalence of co-occurring insomnia symptoms and OSA and to characterize its clinical, comorbidity and polysomnographic profile in a nationwide sleep clinic population. We analysed data from 12,715 adults enrolled in the multicentre Turkish Sleep Apnoea Database (TURKAPNE). All participants underwent full-night laboratory-based polysomnography and completed standardized symptom questionnaires. Participants were categorized into four groups: OSA with co-occurring insomnia symptoms, OSA only, insomnia symptoms only and a reference group with neither OSA nor insomnia symptoms. Multivariable logistic regression analyses were performed to evaluate symptom associations across groups. Of 12,715 participants, 8142 (64.0%) had OSA only, 3275 (25.8%) had OSA with co-occurring insomnia symptoms, 388 (3.1%) had insomnia symptoms only and 910 (7.2%) constituted the reference group. Compared with the reference group, OSA with co-occurring insomnia symptoms was strongly associated with nocturnal dyspnoea (aOR 3.94, 95% CI 3.07-5.04), morning headache (aOR 3.31, 95% CI 2.46-4.44) and depressed mood (aOR 3.01, 95% CI 2.20-4.13). Polysomnography demonstrated respiratory disturbance together with prolonged sleep latency and a higher arousal index in participants with OSA and co-occurring insomnia symptoms. To conclude, in this large national sleep clinic cohort, OSA with co-occurring insomnia symptoms was common and associated with greater clinical complexity and combined respiratory and sleep-continuity disturbances. Systematic assessment of insomnia symptoms in patients evaluated for OSA may improve clinical characterization and support more integrated management approaches. Trial Registration: NCT02784977.

papers.study_type: 回顾性真实世界观察性研究 · 18 个月纵向队列，按应答时间分层探索症状域恢复动力学与基线预测因素
papers.title_zh: 重度嗜酸性粒细胞性哮喘合并鼻息肉患者 benralizumab 治疗 18 个月的分域症状恢复轨迹及快速应答预测因素（真实世界回顾性研究）
papers.title_en: Beyond eosinophil depletion: long-term clinical trajectory and durability of response to benralizumab in patients with severe eosinophilic asthma and CRSwNP: an 18-month real-world study (the BANDOR study).
papers.authors: Bizzi E, Marra AM, Manzotti G, Gidaro A, Ortolani V, Iemoli E, Borgonovo L, Asperti C et al.
papers.affiliation_highlight: Internal Medicine, Vita-Salute San Raffaele University, Milan, Italy.
papers.authors_conclusion: The BANDOR study demonstrates that benralizumab can induce durable clinical remission in a specific subset of patients who maintain treatment adherence. The speed of response is domain specific, with physical symptoms improving before emotional and functional ones. A high initial eosinophilic burden is the primary determinant of a rapid response. These findings suggest that while randomized trials showed limited efficacy, Real-World data identifies a high disease burden phenotype that derives significant long term benefit from receptor targeted eosinophil depletion.
papers.ai_note: 信息不足与方法学疑点：①摘要未给出样本量、效应量及任何 P 值/CI，'显著改善'无法核实；②无对照组的回顾性设计，与既往 RCT 阴性结果的对比属跨研究间接比较，存在适应证选择与指征混杂；③早/晚应答者按结局（应答时间）定义后再回溯基线差异，属结局导向分层，'高嗜酸负荷是快速应答的决定性因素'为观察性关联，措辞强于证据（'primary determinant'）；④主要目标为应答动力学与预测因素，结论却上升至'durable clinical remission'，而摘要未给出缓解（remission）的定义与达成率，存在终点口径松动；⑤未提及混杂因素校正与失访/依从性处理，'maintain treatment adherence'人群限定可能引入幸存者偏倚。
papers.abstract_en: BACKGROUND: The management of patients with severe eosinophilic asthma and chronic rhinosinusitis with nasal polyps requires therapies capable of inducing stable remission. While benralizumab is an established treatment for severe asthma, randomized controlled trials in nasal polyposis have failed to reach primary clinical endpoints or showed inconsistent results. Consequently, there is a lack of evidence regarding its performance in clinical practice. The primary objective of this study was to evaluate the kinetics of response across different symptom domains and to identify predictors of clinical improvement in a Real-World setting in patients affected by severe eosinophilic asthma and chronic rhinosinusitis with nasal polyps. METHODS: This retrospective observational study analyzed a cohort of patients with a United Airways Disease phenotype treated with benralizumab for a continuous period of 18 months. We mapped the longitudinal trajectory of specific SNOT 22 subdomains and lung function. Patients were stratified into early and late responders based on the timing of clinical improvement to identify baseline predictors of rapid versus gradual response. RESULTS: Analysis revealed that SNOT 22 subdomains exhibit distinct recovery patterns. Nasal and physical symptoms showed a significant improvement within the first months of therapy despite the limited success reported in previous clinical trials. In contrast, functional and emotional domains required a longer period of treatment to reach a stable plateau. Early responders were characterized by a significantly higher baseline eosinophil count (median 885 vs 530 cells per microliter) and greater bronchial obstruction at baseline compared to late responders. Functional stability in FEV1 and a reduction in oral corticosteroid use were maintained throughout the observation. CONCLUSIONS: The BANDOR study demonstrates that benralizumab can induce durable clinical remission in a specific subset of patients who maintain treatment adherence. The speed of response is domain specific, with physical symptoms improving before emotional and functional ones. A high initial eosinophilic burden is the primary determinant of a rapid response. These findings suggest that while randomized trials showed limited efficacy, Real-World data identifies a high disease burden phenotype that derives significant long term benefit from receptor targeted eosinophil depletion.

papers.study_type: 队列研究（启发式判定）
papers.title_zh: Progressive pulmonary fibrosis in fibrotic interstitial lung disease: a Danish cohort study.
papers.title_en: Progressive pulmonary fibrosis in fibrotic interstitial lung disease: a Danish cohort study.
papers.authors: Kølner-Augustson L, Knarborg M, Makholm N, Prior T, Davidsen JR, Shaker SB, Bendstrup E, Løkke A et al.
papers.affiliation_highlight: Department of Medicine, Lillebaelt Hospital, Vejle, Denmark.
papers.abstract_en: BACKGROUND: Progressive pulmonary fibrosis (PPF) represents a common disease behaviour across fibrotic interstitial lung diseases (F-ILDs). PPF was defined in 2022, but data on extent and prognosis remain limited. The aim of this study was to determine the proportion of those with F-ILD who progress to PPF, investigate predictors of PPF and compare survival between PPF and non-PPF patients. METHODS: This prospective longitudinal cohort study included all incident cases of F-ILD diagnosed at Danish tertiary interstitial lung disease (ILD) centres between 1 June 2016 and 31 May 2017. Patients with idiopathic pulmonary fibrosis or fewer than two pulmonary function tests were excluded. Data were obtained from the Danish ILD database (DANILDA) and national registries. PPF was defined according to the 2022 criteria. Survival was analysed using Kaplan-Meier estimates and Cox regression with PPF modelled as a time-dependent covariate and delayed entry handled by left truncation. RESULTS: Of the 197 patients included, 57% developed PPF during 4 years of follow-up (median 13 months). No baseline variables predicted PPF development. The PPF group experienced a greater annual decline in forced vital capacity (FVC) (adjusted mean difference -140 mL·year-1; p=0.001) and diffusing capacity of the lung for carbon monoxide (-2.97 percentage points per year; p=0.009) than the non-PPF group. The 3-, 5- and 7-year survival rates were 73%, 58% and 48%, respectively, among those with PPF, and did not differ significantly between people with PPF and those with non-PPF. A higher baseline ILD-gender-age-physiology index (ILD-GAP) stage was independently associated with decreased survival (hazard ratio 2.64; p<0.001). CONCLUSION: In this nationwide real-world cohort, almost six out of 10 patients with F-ILD developed PPF within 4 years. Although patients with PPF exhibited a greater annual decline in FVC, survival rates did not differ between people with PPF and those with non-PPF.

papers.study_type: 超深度宏基因组鸟枪法图谱研究 · 结合生化与结构生物学验证新酶通路（描述性、无对照）

papers.title_en: Metabolic specialization in the gut microbiome of aquatic mammalian herbivores.
papers.authors: Persinoti GF, Martins MP, Silva CBC, Streit RSA, Paixão DAA, Martins GH, Higasi PMR, Braatz GM et al.
papers.affiliation_highlight: Brazilian Biorenewables National Laboratory (LNBR), Brazilian Center for Research in Energy and Materials (CNPEM), Campi…
papers.authors_conclusion: Together, these findings uncover the microbial and metabolic basis of aquatic mammalian herbivory.
papers.ai_note: 研究对象为水生哺乳动物（海牛）肠道微生物生态，与胸科临床业务无关联，按规则归入非肿瘤大类并给低专科分；研究为描述性图谱，无对照组、无临床终点、摘要未报告任何统计学检验（CI/P），机制结论依赖单一新酶通路的个案表征，从MAG推断的酶学功能需谨慎外推
papers.abstract_en: Sirenians, such as manatees, are the only extant mammals fully adapted to aquatic herbivory. Through specialized hindgut fermentation, they play a role in modulating nutrient fluxes and carbon cycling across tropical coastal and riverine ecosystems. However, our understanding of their gut microbiome and its metabolic potential remains elusive. Here we present an ultradeep genomic atlas of the gut microbiome from 47 freshwater and marine manatees spanning distinct developmental stages, comprising 1,215 non-redundant prokaryotic metagenome-assembled genomes and their associated virome. The manatee microbiome encodes a multilayered enzymatic repertoire for plant cell wall deconstruction, including free enzymes, cellulosomes and CAZyme-enriched outer membrane vesicles, alongside diverse pathways for aromatic catabolism. Combining biochemical and structural approaches, we characterize a previously unrecognized enzymatic pathway involving epilactase, which enables a specific Bacillota species to exploit a carbohydrate inaccessible to most microbial life, defining a specialized biochemical strategy for nutrient niche partitioning. Together, these findings uncover the microbial and metabolic basis of aquatic mammalian herbivory.

papers.journal_abbr: Int J Chron Obstruct Pulmon Dis
papers.journal_full: International journal of chronic obstructive pulmonary disease
papers.study_type: 单中心回顾性队列研究 · 机器学习预测模型开发与70/30内部验证
papers.title_zh: 中重度COPD患者3个月非计划再入院风险的机器学习预测模型：单中心回顾性队列开发与内部验证（XGBoost验证集AUC 0.809）
papers.title_en: Development and Validation of a Machine Learning Model for Predicting Three-Month Unplanned Readmission in Patients with Moderate-to-Severe Chronic Obstructive Pulmonary Disease: A Retrospective Cohort Study.
papers.authors: Yu S, Wei H, Chen Q, Li N, Jiang Z, Ma H
papers.affiliation_highlight: Department of Respiratory and Critical Care Medicine, Chest Hospital, Tianjin University, Tianjin, People's Republic of …
papers.authors_conclusion: XGBoost模型在预测COPD患者非计划再入院风险的内部验证中表现出有前景的性能；但鉴于样本量小、单中心设计，这些发现应谨慎解读；未来研究应使用来自不同地理区域的前瞻性、多中心数据对外部验证并更新模型
papers.ai_note: 仅70/30单次随机拆分的内部验证，无外部验证或交叉验证报告，AUC的95%CI宽达0.690-0.927，提示估计不稳定；摘要称评估了校准曲线与DCA但未给出任何数值，属选择性报告；未与现有再入院风险评分（如LACE类）作对比，无法判断ML相对简单工具的增益；样本299例、事件59例对6种模型（含神经网络）比较偏少，存在过拟合风险；数据收集时间窗终点为2026年1月，与实际投稿时点是否匹配信息不足
papers.abstract_en: PURPOSE: Patients with moderate-to-severe chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (COPD) face a high risk of three-month unplanned readmission after discharge, yet early identification of high-risk patients remains challenging in clinical practice. This study aimed to develop and validate machine learning (ML) models for predicting the risk and providing a reference for the subsequent development and updating of predictive tools. METHODS: This single-center retrospective cohort study involved individuals with moderate-to-severe COPD from Tianjin Chest Hospital (January 2023 to January 2026). Participants were randomly split into a 70% training set and a 30% validation set. Least absolute shrinkage and selection operator (LASSO) regression identified candidate predictors for model development. Six models were constructed: logistic regression (LR), support vector machine (SVM), Extreme Gradient Boosting (XGBoost), Light Gradient Boosting Machine (LightGBM), Backpropagation Neural Network (BPNN), and Naive Bayes (NB). Model performance was assessed through the area under the receiver operating characteristic (ROC) curve (AUC), sensitivity (SEN), and specificity (SPE). Calibration was evaluated through calibration curves, and clinical utility via decision curve analysis (DCA). RESULTS: 299 patients with moderate-to-severe COPD were enrolled, and 59 (20%) experienced unplanned readmission within three months after discharge. Six ML models were compared, and the XGBoost model exhibited the best performance in the validation cohort, with an AUC of 0.809 (95% CI: 0.690-0.927), SEN of 0.750, and SPE of 0.826. SHapley Additive exPlanations (SHAP) analysis ranked the key predictive factors in descending order: history of hospitalization in the past year, FEV1, history of coronary heart disease, and smoking history. CONCLUSION: XGBoost model showed promising performance in internal validation for predicting the risk of unplanned readmission among patients with moderate-to-severe COPD. However, these findings should be interpreted cautiously given the small sample size, single-center design. Future studies should use prospective, multicenter data from diverse geographic regions to externally validate and update the model.

papers.study_type: 回顾性队列研究（MIMIC-IV数据库）· HACOR评分与多时间点全因死亡率的关联分析
papers.title_zh: 基于MIMIC-IV回顾性队列：HACOR评分≥6与急性低氧性呼吸衰竭患者28、90、365天全因死亡率升高相关
papers.title_en: Association between the HACOR score and mortality in patients with acute hypoxemic respiratory failure: a retrospective cohort study.
papers.authors: Wang K, Ou Y, Li L
papers.affiliation_highlight: Department of Respiratory and Critical Care Medicine, The Second Affiliated Hospital of Chongqing Medical University, Ch…
papers.authors_conclusion: 本研究证实AHRF患者HACOR评分升高与28天、90天、365天死亡率升高显著相关；每升高1分死亡风险增加，HACOR=6处阈值效应显著；这些发现凸显了HACOR评分在临床实践中风险分层的效用。
papers.ai_note: 摘要未报告任何区分度指标（AUC/C-index）、校准或Hazard Ratio及其95%CI，仅有P值，无法评估预测效能与效应量大小。阈值取自样本中位数二分（<6 vs ≥6），随后称HACOR=6为'显著阈值效应'，属数据驱动阈值，存在乐观偏倚风险，未见外部验证队列。亚组分析未提及多重比较校正。作者结论中'风险分层的效用'超出仅报告关联P值所能支持的预测学证据（信息不足：判别/校准性能）。
papers.abstract_en: BACKGROUND: Acute hypoxemic respiratory failure (AHRF) is a common critical condition in the intensive care unit (ICU). Accurate early prediction of the risk of death is of great significance for clinical decision-making. Although HACOR score was initially used to predict the failure of non-invasive ventilation in acute hypoxemic respiratory failure (AHRF) patients, the relationship between the HACOR score and the mortality remains unclear. Therefore, a retrospective cohort study was conducted to evaluate the ability of the HACOR score to predict mortality risk in patients with AHRF. METHOD: Patients diagnosed with AHRF were extracted from the MIMIC-IV database and divided into two groups (low‑risk < 6 vs. high‑risk ≥ 6) based on the median HACOR score. The relationship between the HACOR score and all‑cause mortality at 28, 90, and 365 days was evaluated. To investigate the association between HACOR score and mortality in AHRF patients, restricted cubic spline (RCS) analysis and Cox proportional hazards regression were performed. RESULT: This study included 2774 patients (median age 68 years, IQR 57-79; 57.9% male). The mortality rates in the high-risk group (HACOR ≥ 6) were significantly higher than those in the low-risk group (< 6) at 28 days, 90 days, and 365 days (28 days: 38.3% vs. 28.2%, P < 0.001; 90 days: 46.1% vs. 35.7%, P < 0.001; 365 days: 52.5% vs. 44.3%, P < 0.001). Kaplan-Meier analysis demonstrated that the survival probability of the high-risk group was lower (log-rank P < 0.001). Cox regression analysis indicated that for every 1-point increase in the HACOR score, the risk of death significantly increased (P < 0.001), and restricted cubic spline analysis revealed a linear association between the score and mortality, with a significant threshold effect at HACOR = 6. Subgroup analysis further showed that a HACOR score ≥ 6 was consistently associated with a 28-day mortality rate across various demographic and clinical characteristics (all P < 0.05), reinforcing the robustness of the score. CONCLUSION: This study confirmed that an increase in the HACOR score was significantly associated with an increased mortality rate at 28 days, 90 days, and 365 days in patients with AHRF. For every 1-point increase in the score, the risk of death increased, and the threshold effect was significant when HACOR = 6. These findings highlight the utility of the HACOR score for risk stratification in clinical practice.

papers.title_en: Synthetic immunological niche reveals early immune dysregulation and stratifies therapeutic response in type 1 diabetes.
papers.authors: Roy J, Jiang Y, Mao R, King JL, Talekar A, Liu D, Holman L, Zeng H et al.
papers.affiliation_highlight: Department of Biomedical Engineering, University of Michigan, Ann Arbor, United States of America.
papers.authors_conclusion: 这些发现确立了IN作为检测阶段性免疫失调和分层免疫治疗反应的平台

papers.abstract_en: In Type 1 Diabetes (T1D), disease onset and immunotherapy responses vary widely, reflecting heterogeneous stage-specific immune dysregulation that remains undefined. To investigate this heterogeneity, we engineered microporous polycaprolactone scaffolds that form synthetic immunological niches (INs) subcutaneously and capture tissue-associated systemic immune changes. Building on our prior demonstration of IN-based longitudinal T1D monitoring, we use multimodal IN profiling to define the immune changes underlying divergent disease trajectories and immunotherapy responses. In non-obese diabetic (NOD) mice, longitudinal transcriptomic profiling of IN identified early myeloid associated changes, followed by increasing T cell-associated dysregulation that distinguished progressors from non-progressors. An early-stage IN-based T1D gene signature stratified NOD progressors from non-progressors by 6 weeks of age and was conserved across human T1D tissues, distinguishing T1D from non-diabetic individuals in spleen and pancreatic lymph node samples, but not in peripheral blood. Signature-based stratification revealed macrophage-associated TNFα pathway enrichment in pancreas of NOD progressors, which was validated in human T1D islets. Given the heterogeneous response to anti-TNFα therapy, IN profiling identified genesets associated with anti-TNFα efficacy and generated a response score that prospectively distinguished treatment-sensitive from resistant mice. These findings establish IN as a platform for detecting stage-wise immune dysregulation and stratifying immunotherapy response in T1D.

papers.affiliation_highlight: University of the Basque Country UPV/EHU, San Sebastian, Spain.
papers.authors_conclusion: These results underscore the efficacy of fusing self-supervised semantic representations with segmentation-informed anatomical cues to enhance robustness against dataset bias, acquisition variability, and cross-domain shifts. The proposed approach offers a reliable foundation for multi-dataset and multi-modality medical image classification in research-oriented decision-support systems.
papers.ai_note: 信息不足：未见外部/机构私有验证集，全部为公开benchmark，泛化与跨域声明缺乏独立数据支撑；COVID-19 AUC 0.998 极接近完美，提示可能存在公开数据集已知的采集偏倚/短视捷径，与摘要自称抗dataset bias存在张力；仅称'多数数据集与指标'改善，未逐一披露阴性数据集与主要/次要终点定义，亦无与放射科医师判读的对照；无效应量的CI或校准/临床效用指标；皮肤病变任务与胸科业务无关，拉高多模态表象；单一框架内部比较，外部SOTA为已发表数字而非同协议复跑。
papers.abstract_en: Robust medical image classification remains a persistent challenge due to heterogeneous acquisition protocols, label noise, and subtle inter-class variability. In chest radiography, these difficulties are compounded by shortcut learning from non-anatomical artifacts and projection variability, which severely undermine generalization. To address these limitations, we propose DINOv3-SAM, a dual-encoder framework that synergistically integrates complementary visual representations. The architecture combines a self-supervised DINOv3 vision transformer, which captures global semantic context, with the Segment Anything Model (SAM) image encoder, which provides anatomy-aware spatial features. The two feature streams are spatially aligned and adaptively refined through a Convolutional Block Attention Module (CBAM), which emphasizes informative channels and diagnostically relevant regions prior to classification. Notably, only the final DINOv3 layers are fine-tuned while SAM remains frozen, yielding a computationally efficient framework with only 5.3 million trainable parameters. We evaluate DINOv3-SAM across five public datasets spanning diverse modalities and diagnostic tasks: pediatric pneumonia classification, cardiomegaly detection, large-scale RSNA pneumonia detection, COVID-19 radiography, and dermatological lesion classification. A unified stratified train/validation/test protocol ensures consistent and fair evaluation across both binary and multi-class settings. Each configuration was trained three times with different random seeds, and comprehensive comparisons against reproduced CNN baselines and published state-of-the-art methods, supported by statistical significance testing, demonstrate improvements across most datasets and metrics. The proposed framework achieves a mean accuracy of 94.94% (±3.06) on pediatric pneumonia, 97.24% (±0.77) accuracy (AUC 0.998 ±0.001) on COVID-19 radiography, and a mean AUC of 0.8705 (±0.0445) on the challenging RSNA benchmark. These results underscore the efficacy of fusing self-supervised semantic representations with segmentation-informed anatomical cues to enhance robustness against dataset bias, acquisition variability, and cross-domain shifts. The proposed approach offers a reliable foundation for multi-dataset and multi-modality medical image classification in research-oriented decision-support systems.

papers.authors: Hu JH, Hu YB, Yu LH, Ge XT, Shang XG, Tai WC, Dong LF, Zhang YW et al.
papers.affiliation_highlight: School of Pharmacy, Zhejiang Provincial Key Laboratory of Anti-Cancer Chinese Medicines and Natural Medicines, Hangzhou …
papers.authors_conclusion: Altogether, β-ELE promotes the efficacy of OSI via suppressing IGF1R/AREG-mediated EMT in OSI treated NSCLC cells, supporting the co-administration of β-ELE and OSI as a novel integrative strategy for NSCLC treatment.
papers.ai_note: 纯临床前研究，摘要未报告任何效应量、CI或P值，无法评估效应大小；结论基于'AXL低表达'这一经初筛限定的细胞亚群，人群/生物标志物限定是否可外推至患者信息不足；作者自述β-ELE单药抗NSCLC效应'relatively moderate'，联用增效幅度未量化；耐药机制（IGF1R代偿激活）为细胞系模型推断，缺乏患者样本验证，临床转化信息不足。
papers.abstract_en: β-elemene (β-ELE) is the principal active component of Elemene, and its anti-NSCLC effect is relatively moderate. However, it shows promising potential in synergistically enhancing the efficacy of chemotherapeutic agents. Osimertinib (OSI) is a third EGFR tyrosine kinase inhibitor that selectively inhibits mutant EGFR. However, OSI lacks cross-inhibitory activity against IGF1R and tends to induce compensatory activation of IGF1R signaling, which is a key factor contributing to OSI tolerance in AXL-low-expression NSCLC cells. Therefore, combining OSI with IGF1R inhibitors is a promising regimen for improving therapeutic efficacy. Based on preliminary screening, we found that β-ELE exhibits binding affinity and inhibitory activity toward IGF1R. It notably increased the anticancer effect of OSI both in vitro and in vivo in AXL-low expression EGFR mutant NSCLC. Mechanistically, β-ELE combined with OSI attenuated OSI induced activation of IGF1R, promoting the inhibition of cancer cell proliferation and EMT, which could be partially abolished by IGF1R overexpression. RNA-seq analysis revealed that AREG is a key downregulated gene transcriptionally regulated by IGF1R in β-ELE + OSI treated cells. β-ELE + OSI induced EMT inhibition was reversed by IGF1R overexpression, but could be restored via AREG knockdown in IGF1R overexpressed NSCLC cells. Furthermore, β-ELE + OSI increased the binding between IGF1R and amphiregulin (AREG), promoting IGF1R nuclear translocation, which were both observed in vitro and in vivo. Altogether, β-ELE promotes the efficacy of OSI via suppressing IGF1R/AREG-mediated EMT in OSI treated NSCLC cells, supporting the co-administration of β-ELE and OSI as a novel integrative strategy for NSCLC treatment.

papers.title_en: 13β,21-dihydroeurycomanone induces pyroptosis in lung adenocarcinoma cells via activating RIG-1/Caspase-1/GSDMD pathway.
papers.authors: Li H, Wang T, Gao Z, Wu X, Ding Q, Zou J, Li X, Zhu S et al.
papers.affiliation_highlight: Collaborative Innovation Center for Antitumor Active Substance Research and Development, School of Basic Medical Science…
papers.authors_conclusion: our results indicate that DHEN exhibits its anti-tumor activity in LUAD cells by inducing pyroptosis through activating the RIG-1/Caspase-1/GSDMD pathway, thus highlighting DHEN as a potential chemotherapeutic agent with low toxicity for LUAD treatment
papers.ai_note: 摘要全文无任何定量数值（无IC50、抑瘤率、统计学P值或CI），无法评估效应量与统计可靠性，信息不足；结论基于两株细胞系加单一异种移植模型，缺少患者来源类器官或PDX验证，外推至患者人群证据薄弱；'low toxicity'仅依据BEAS-2B无明显细胞毒与健康小鼠无明显全身毒性，缺乏系统毒理学与药代数据支撑；机制上RIG-1敲除与VX-765回补虽为双向验证，但未报告敲除效率与回补的量化程度；焦亡标志物仅以蛋白表达与分泌变化描述，无定量统计
papers.abstract_en: Pyroptosis, an inflammatory and lytic form of programmed cell death, has emerged as a promising therapeutic platform for lung adenocarcinoma (LUAD) treatment. The role of 13β,21-dihydroeurycomanone (DHEN), a quassinoid isolated from the root extract of Eurycoma longifolia, in pyroptosis induction of LUAD cells remains unclear. Here, we found that DHEN significantly inhibited the proliferation of A549 and NCI-H1975 cells, two LUAD cell lines, but had no obvious cytotoxic effects on normal human bronchial epithelial cells (BEAS-2B). Animal experiments further revealed that DHEN inhibited the growth of human LUAD xenograft tumors in nude mice with no obvious systemic toxicity to healthy mice. Morphologically, DHEN induced pyroptosis-like morphological changes in LUAD cells. Correspondingly, DHEN inhibited the expression of Pro-Caspase-1 and gasdermin D (GSDMD) proteins , and promoted the expression of Cleaved-Caspase-1, Cleaved-N-terminal GSDMD (GSDMD-N), NLRP3, and NLRC4 proteins, accompanied with concomitant increase of Caspase-1 activity, interleukin (IL)1β and IL18 mRNA expression, and IL1β and IL18 secretion in LUAD cells. As expected, VX-765, a specific pyroptotic inhibitor, significantly abrogated DHEN-induced proliferation inhibition, GSDMD cleavage, and IL1β and IL18 secretion. Mechanically, DHEN up-regulated RIG-1 expression, while RIG-1 knockout significantly abrogated DHEN-induced proliferation inhibition, pyroptosis-like morphology changes, Pro-Caspase-1 and GSDMD protein cleavage, NLRP3 protein expression, Caspase-1 activation, and IL1β and IL18 secretion in LUAD cells. Taken together, our results indicate that DHEN exhibits its anti-tumor activity in LUAD cells by inducing pyroptosis through activating the RIG-1/Caspase-1/GSDMD pathway, thus highlighting DHEN as a potential chemotherapeutic agent with low toxicity for LUAD treatment.

papers.title_zh: Lessons learned from a decade of EUS(-FNA) staging in esophageal and GEJ carcinoma: towards a selective staging strategy.
papers.title_en: Lessons learned from a decade of EUS(-FNA) staging in esophageal and GEJ carcinoma: towards a selective staging strategy.
papers.authors: Quik JSE, van Sandick JW, Owers EC, Bartels-Rutten A, Voncken FEM, Kodach LL, de Wijkerslooth TR, van Dieren JM et al.
papers.affiliation_highlight: Department of Surgical Oncology, The Netherlands Cancer Institute - Antoni van Leeuwenhoek, Amsterdam, The Netherlands.
papers.abstract_en: Endoscopic ultrasonography with fine-needle aspiration (EUS(-FNA)) is recommended by current guidelines as part of the staging for esophageal and gastro-esophageal junction (GEJ) carcinoma, yet its incremental value over modern 18F-fluorodeoxyglucose positron emission tomography (FDG-PET) remains uncertain. This Lessons Learned article reflects on over a decade of EUS(-FNA) and FDG-PET staging in 402 patients with potentially curable esophageal or GEJ carcinoma at a high-volume tertiary referral center. In 91.3% of patients, EUS(-FNA) did not alter the radiation field as would have been defined by FDG-PET. EUS(-FNA) resulted in an expansion of the radiation field in 4.5% and reduction in 4.2% of patients. Squamous cell carcinoma showed more than two-fold greater likelihood of radiation field modification. Among 193 patients classified as FDG-PET non-suspicious for malignant lymph nodes (LNs), EUS-FNA identified malignant LNs in eight patients (4.1%), which influenced the radiation field. In 5 of 402 patients (1.2%) a malignant LN was detected with EUS-FNA in a station that would not have routinely been resected surgically. In patients planned for neoadjuvant or definitive chemoradiotherapy (CRT), LN staging is of direct therapeutic consequence: underestimation of nodal disease may result in geographic miss, while overestimation leads to unnecessary irradiation. In contrast, in patients treated with perioperative 5-fluorouracil, leucovorin, oxaliplatin and docetaxel (FLOT) followed by surgical lymphadenectomy, most involved LN stations are routinely addressed surgically, limiting the added value of EUS(-FNA) for treatment planning. Therefore, we view EUS(-FNA) as a selective staging tool in patients planned for neoadjuvant or definitive CRT, rather than a procedure applied routinely to all patients.

papers.abstract_en: BACKGROUND AND OBJECTIVE: Sinonasal symptoms are common in chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (COPD); however, their clinical significance remains unclear. This study investigated whether patient-reported sinonasal symptoms are associated with COPD exacerbation history and whether multidimensional patient-reported outcome (PRO) assessment identifies a distinct sinonasal symptom-dominant phenotype. METHODS: This multicenter cross-sectional study included 442 patients with COPD. Sinonasal symptoms, COPD health status, and frailty were assessed using the 22-item Sino-Nasal Outcome Test (SNOT-22), COPD Assessment Test (CAT), and Kihon Checklist (KCL), respectively. Associations between the SNOT-22 scores and COPD exacerbation history or frailty were evaluated using logistic regression analysis. Domain-level analyses were performed using the previously reported SNOT-22 domains. PRO-based phenotyping was performed using unsupervised k-prototype clustering of the SNOT-22, CAT, and KCL items. RESULTS: Patient-reported sinonasal symptoms were common, with discordance between patient and physician reports. Higher SNOT-22 scores were associated with COPD exacerbation history and frailty. Domain-level analyses showed that the nasal symptom domain was associated with exacerbation history, whereas the emotional domain was associated with frailty. PRO-based clustering identified four clinically interpretable phenotypes, including a nasal symptom-dominant phenotype associated with COPD exacerbation history. CONCLUSION: Patient-reported sinonasal symptoms are common and clinically relevant in COPD, with discordance between patient and physician reports. This study identified a nasal symptom-dominant phenotype associated with COPD exacerbation history, highlighting the potential value of upper airway assessment in personalized COPD management and suggesting that sinonasal symptoms may represent a candidate treatable trait.

papers.title_en: Gαq-coupled receptors activate cAMP signaling through Ca2+/calmodulin-stimulated adenylyl cyclases.
papers.authors: Ding Q, An L, Ren J, Williams N, Wang H
papers.affiliation_highlight: Department of Physiology, Neuroscience Program, Michigan State University, East Lansing, MI 48824, USA.
papers.authors_conclusion: 我们的研究结果凸显了Gαq-GPCRs通过不同的ADCYs调控cAMP信号这一非传统功能
papers.ai_note: 该研究为神经科学基础信号通路研究（小鼠海马离体切片），与胸部肿瘤/胸外科临床业务无直接关联，仅作为GPCR-cAMP交叉知识参考；摘要未提供样本量、统计学检验、效应量或CI等定量信息，定量稳健性信息不足；结论主要依赖ADCY1/ADCY8敲除切片的缺失表型与离体切片体系，外推至在体生理情境及人体存在限度
papers.abstract_en: Among the various G protein-mediated intracellular signaling pathways activated by G protein-coupled receptors (GPCRs), Gαs and Gαi stimulate and inhibit adenylyl cyclases (ADCYs), leading to increases and decreases in cAMP abundance, respectively. Here, we investigated the contribution of Gαq-coupled receptors (Gαq-GPCRs), which typically activate phospholipase C (PLC) and stimulate intracellular Ca2+ generation, to the regulation of cAMP signaling. We activated the endogenous Gαq-coupled muscarinic acetylcholine receptors (Gαq-mAChRs) and the group 1 metabotropic glutamate receptors (mGluR1/5) in ex vivo hippocampal slices from mice. We also used a chemogenetics approach to activate Gαq-DREADDs (designer receptors exclusively activated by designer drugs) through hM3Dq. We found that stimulation of these Gαq-GPCRs not only increased the abundance of cAMP but also activated downstream, cAMP-mediated intracellular signaling pathways. This GPCR-dependent cAMP signaling required both Gαq activity and intracellular Ca2+. Additionally, hippocampal slices from mice lacking the Ca2+/calmodulin-stimulated ADCYs, ADCY1 and ADCY8, did not exhibit Gαq-GPCR-mediated cAMP signaling and showed impaired synaptic long-term depression (LTD) mediated by Gαq-mAChRs. Together, our findings highlight a nonconventional function of Gαq-GPCRs in regulating cAMP signaling through distinct ADCYs.

papers.title_en: Fatty acid dysregulation in asthma: linking immunometabolic remodeling, phenotypic heterogeneity, and metabolic precision medicine.
papers.authors: Yuan Y, Peng Y
papers.affiliation_highlight: Department of Respiratory and Critical Care Medicine, Second Affiliated Hospital of Naval Medical University, Shanghai, …
papers.authors_conclusion: We further present a conceptual framework in which metabolic, inflammatory, and structural alterations may interact to contribute to persistent airway remodeling. Finally, we discuss the emerging translational potential of lipidomic-guided phenotyping and metabolism-directed interventions, while emphasizing that these approaches remain investigational and require prospective clinical validation.
papers.ai_note: 叙述性综述，摘要未报告检索策略、纳入标准或文献筛选流程，方法学透明度信息不足；作者自述人体证据多为关联性、功能证据主要来自动物与离体研究，因果强度有限；作者强调脂质组学引导的表型分型与代谢干预'仍属研究性、需前瞻性临床验证'，结论口径本身较为克制，无明显阳性偏倚，但作为综述其对临床决策的直接影响有限。
papers.abstract_en: Asthma is a highly heterogeneous chronic airway disease characterized by diverse inflammatory endotypes, variable airway remodeling patterns, and differential therapeutic responses. Although current classifications mainly rely on immune phenotypes, they do not fully explain severe steroid resistance, obesity-associated asthma, and inflammation-independent structural remodeling. Immunometabolic dysregulation, particularly fatty acid metabolic imbalance, has emerged as an additional dimension associated with asthma heterogeneity and the interplay among systemic metabolic status with airway inflammation and remodeling. In this review, we summarize major features of fatty acid dysregulation in asthma, including altered circulating and airway lipid profiles, PUFA-derived mediator imbalance, SFA-associated metabolic stress, and cell-type-specific alterations in fatty acid uptake, synthesis, oxidation, and storage. These alterations may affect airway epithelial cells, macrophages, lymphocytes, airway smooth muscle cells, and fibroblasts, thereby influencing epithelial barrier integrity, inflammatory programming, smooth muscle remodeling, and extracellular matrix deposition. Human studies have identified phenotype-associated lipid signatures, including AA-derived inflammatory mediators such as cysteinyl leukotrienes and PGD2 metabolites in T2-high asthma and alterations in linoleic acid and glycerophospholipid metabolism across granulocytic phenotypes, whereas obesity-associated asthma additionally reflects systemic metabolic disturbances arising from the adipose-lung axis. Much of the current human evidence remains associative, whereas functional support for specific fatty acids, lipid mediators, and metabolic pathways is derived largely from experimental and ex vivo studies. We further present a conceptual framework in which metabolic, inflammatory, and structural alterations may interact to contribute to persistent airway remodeling. Finally, we discuss the emerging translational potential of lipidomic-guided phenotyping and metabolism-directed interventions, while emphasizing that these approaches remain investigational and require prospective clinical validation.

papers.abstract_en: Pathogenic SCN2A loss-of-function (LoF) variants can cause severe, refractory epilepsy with limited treatment options. Existing Scn2a-LoF mouse models exhibit few spontaneous seizures, limiting the dynamic range needed to assess therapeutic efficacy. We therefore generated gene-trap Scn2a-deficient mice on the seizure-prone DBA/2J background. These mice experienced hundreds of spontaneous absence seizures per day, characterized by concurrent behavioral arrest and EEG spike-wave discharges (SWDs). Partial restoration of Scn2a expression reduced seizure burden. Electrophysiological analysis revealed impaired action potential waveforms yet increased repetitive firing, alongside coordinated downregulation of voltage-gated potassium channel genes, potentially contributing to hyperexcitability. Given the broad potassium channel downregulation and prior efficacy of KCNA1 gene therapy in refractory seizure models, we selected KV1.1 as a potential therapeutic target and used a drug-controllable adeno-associated virus (AAV) to express human KCNA1. We found that this intervention normalized elevated neuronal firing and reduced spontaneous seizure burden in Scn2a-deficient mice. Extending these findings to a human cell-based platform, AAV-mediated KCNA1 expression also reduced neuronal firing in human cortical organoids carrying a SCN2A-truncating variant identified in patients. Together, these findings provide proof of principle for drug-controllable KCNA1 gene therapy as a promising treatment avenue for epilepsy related to SCN2A LoF variants.

papers.abstract_en: INTRODUCTION: Sepsis-associated acute lung injury (SALI) is a life-threatening pulmonary complication of sepsis with high mortality. This study aimed to prioritize serum metabolites and genes potentially involved in SALI by integrating multi-omics datasets. METHODS: A rat SALI model treated with Xuanbai Chengqi Decoction (XCD) was subjected to untargeted serum metabolomics. Bulk and single-cell RNA-seq datasets were retrieved from GEO, and metabolite-related GWAS statistics were obtained from IEU OpenGWAS. scPagwas mapped metabolite genetic signals to cell populations; hdWGCNA identified cell signature genes. Candidate genes were filtered by overlapping bulk DEGs, ten machine-learning models and expression validation. Functional enrichment, immune infiltration, cell -cell communication, pseudotime and scTenifoldKnk virtual knockdown analyses were performed. RESULTS: Oleoylcarnitine showed the strongest genetic association with T cells. Cross-platform integration prioritized GIMAP4 and RCBTB2 as hub genes, with WBP2 retained for further validation. Their expression correlated with altered immune infiltration, especially eosinophils, and the three-gene profiles shared 62 biological processes. SALI exhibited increased number and strength of cell interactions compared with isolated sepsis. Five T-cell subsets were identified, and virtual knockdown of hub genes modified regulation of eight DEGs. DISCUSSION: Oleoylcarnitine-associated metabolic changes are correlated with T-cell dysregulation mediated by GIMAP4, RCBTB2, and WBP2 in SALI. These findings are descriptive, and further experiments are required to establish causal relationships.

papers.abstract_en: Obesity is a well-established risk factor for increased incidence and mortality in multiple cancers, including breast cancer. However, the key molecular mechanisms linking obesity to breast cancer progression remain incompletely understood. In this study, using several high-fat diet-induced obesity models, we demonstrate that obesity promotes breast cancer lung metastasis through elevated levels of adipocyte-derived circulating FABP4. Mechanistically, circulating FABP4 directly binds to a subset of breast cancer cells via the membrane lipid PIP2. This FABP4/PIP2 interaction activates PKC signaling and enhances mitochondrial ROS production, driving cancer cell migration. Genetic deletion of FABP4, either globally or specifically in adipocytes, markedly reduces obesity-associated metastasis. Moreover, therapeutic targeting of circulating FABP4 using a distinctive neutralizing monoclonal antibody significantly suppresses breast cancer metastasis in multiple preclinical models. Together, these findings identify the FABP4/PIP2 axis as a key mechanism underlying obesity-driven breast cancer and highlight it as a promising therapeutic target for treating metastatic breast cancer.

papers.abstract_en: Hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC) typically arises within fibrotic, mechanically rigid microenvironments where matrix stiffness directly drives primary tumor proliferation and invasion. However, whether and how tumor cells retain these mechanical adaptations upon disseminating to softer metastatic sites has remained unclear. In this issue of Cancer Research, Luo and colleagues demonstrate that HCC cells retain a "mechanical memory" of matrix stiffness that persists even after metastasizing to soft secondary niches, such as the lungs. Mechanistically, this memory is mediated by contractility-dependent suppression of mitochondrial fission. The resulting accumulation of acetyl-CoA fuels sustained histone hyperacetylation, preserving a proliferative state across subsequent cell generations. These findings uncover a novel mechano-metabolic-epigenetic axis that sustains HCC proliferation during metastatic dissemination. See related article by Luo et al., p. 5354.

papers.abstract_en: BACKGROUND: Pirfenidone, approved for idiopathic pulmonary fibrosis (IPF), slows lung function decline and reduces fibrosis, including in post-COVID-19 pulmonary fibrosis. Its early use in acute respiratory distress syndrome (ARDS) remains uncertain. This study evaluated the effects of early pirfenidone administration on short- and long-term outcomes in pulmonary infection-related ARDS. METHODS: In this prospective cohort study, 97 ARDS patients were consecutively recruited and assigned to Pirfenidone (n = 29), Glucocorticoid (n = 38), or Control (n = 30) groups according to the severity and clinical course of the disease by the attending clinical team, all receiving standard care. Short-term outcomes included 28-day mortality, ICU length of stay, and hospital length of stay. Long-term outcomes at 3 and 6 months included chest CT fibrosis score, pulmonary function [forced vital capacity (FVC) and diffusing capacity for carbon monoxide (DLCO)], SpO2/FiO2 ratio, modified Medical Research Council (mMRC) dyspnea score, and Activities of Daily Living (ADL) score. Safety was assessed via adverse events and laboratory parameters. RESULTS: At 6 months, the Pirfenidone Group had significantly lower chest CT fibrosis scores than the Glucocorticoid Group [3.0 (0.0-6.5) vs. 6.0 (4.0-8.0), p < 0.05], which was comparable to that of the Control Group. FVC, SpO2/FiO2, and ADL scores at 3 and 6 months were significantly higher in the Pirfenidone Group compared with both Glucocorticoid and Control groups (all p < 0.01). Long-term outcomes improved relative to baseline (p < 0.05). Short-term outcomes, mMRC scores, and safety indicators showed no significant differences among groups (p > 0.05). No severe drug-related adverse events were observed. CONCLUSION: Early pirfenidone administration in pulmonary infection-related ARDS enhances long-term functional recovery and reduces fibrosis without increasing safety risks, although it does not significantly impact short-term outcomes. These findings support the consideration of early antifibrotic therapy in ARDS management.

papers.abstract_en: People with HIV (PWH) are at increased risk of a broad range of infectious and non-infectious pulmonary diseases. Since the last ATS Workshop on HIV-associated pulmonary disease, large national and international cohorts have demonstrated ongoing gaps in our understanding of lung disease in this vulnerable population that range from underappreciation of disease incidence and prevalence to lack of targeted treatments. Translational work on the underlying mechanisms of disease has demonstrated novel, HIV-specific mechanisms that may lend themselves to tailored therapies. Twenty-four experts in HIV-associated lung disease from across the translational spectrum were invited to participate in this ATS-sponsored Workshop utilizing a modified Delphi method that included a series of pre- and post-workshop electronic surveys and a two-day virtual workshop. Lung disease among PWH is driven by complex and interrelated mechanisms including persistent immune dysregulation, oxidative stress, accelerated aging, and microbiome alterations. Despite these advances in our understanding, important gaps persist between mechanistic insights and clinical care that include limited HIV-specific trials, underrepresentation of PWH in studies of lung disease, and the absence of tailored care strategies. These gaps are further accentuated by substantial variation in the availability of data from the most affected populations, particularly in sub-Saharan Africa and among children and adolescents. Overcoming these challenges will require coordinated, globally representative research efforts that leverage large cohorts, integrate multi-omics and longitudinal phenotyping, use mechanistic insights to inform clinical trials, and consider implementation science approaches with the ultimate goal of developing tailored prevention and treatment strategies for HIV-associated pulmonary diseases.

papers.abstract_en: BACKGROUND: Community-acquired pneumonia (CAP) remains a major global health concern. Mycoplasma pneumoniae (M. pneumoniae) and Chlamydia pneumoniae (C. pneumoniae) are important atypical CAP pathogens, and reported coinfection may complicate diagnosis and management. However, no licensed vaccine simultaneously targeting both pathogens is currently available. In this context, mRNA-based multi-epitope vaccines represent a promising platform for bivalent vaccine design because they allow the integration of multiple epitopes into a single construct and may support both humoral and cellular immune responses. This study aimed to design bivalent multi-epitope mRNA vaccine candidates against M. pneumoniae and C. pneumoniae using an immunoinformatics-based strategy. METHODS: Conserved cytotoxic T-lymphocyte (CTL), helper T-lymphocyte (HTL), and linear B lymphocyte (LBL) epitopes were screened from selected antigenic proteins. Two constructs, MCV1 and MCV2, were assembled with distinct N-terminal immunostimulatory or helper-epitope modules and evaluated for antigenicity, safety, physicochemical and structural properties, receptor docking, three independent 100-ns molecular dynamics simulations, replicate-level MM-PBSA, immune simulation, population coverage, human codon optimization, and RNA secondary structure. RESULTS: A total of 11 CTL, 5 HTL, and 14 LBL epitopes with ≥ 90% conservancy among the analyzed strain sequences were selected. Both core constructs were predicted to be antigenic, non-toxic, non-allergenic, and structurally acceptable. HADDOCK refinement yielded cluster-level scores of - 394.3 ± 7.3 for MCV1-TLR2 and - 399.0 ± 5.5 for the exploratory MCV2-TLR4 complex. Across three independent trajectories, MM-PBSA total binding free energies were - 125.19 ± 20.13 and - 126.87 ± 12.73 kcal/mol, respectively. C-ImmSim generated modeled profiles involving humoral and cellular immune components, and the estimated global population coverage was 97.90%. Human codon optimization yielded codon adaptation index values of 0.92 and 0.91 and GC contents of 61.06% and 60.94% for MCV1 and MCV2, respectively. CONCLUSION: In this in silico study, two bivalent multi-epitope mRNA vaccine candidates against M. pneumoniae and C. pneumoniae were computationally prioritized. These findings provide a theoretical basis for subsequent experimental validation, while in vitro and in vivo studies are still required to verify their actual immunogenicity, protective efficacy, and safety.

papers.abstract_en: BACKGROUND: Integrative transcriptomic analyses can prioritize genes associated with chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (COPD), but expression associations require experimental assessment. METHODS: Single-cell GSE173896 and bulk GSE57148 data were analyzed using clustering, co-expression networks, CellChat, differential expression, immune deconvolution, pseudotime, and virtual knockout analysis. A five-gene logistic nomogram was developed in GSE57148. Clinical RT-qPCR included 30 participants with COPD and 30 without COPD. Two independent IL6-targeting siRNAs were examined in HBEC3-KT and BEAS-2B cells using epithelial-macrophage co-culture, cytokine measurements, and wound-healing assays. RESULTS: NHSL2, CDKL5, CRIP1, TNNI2, and IL6 were prioritized as candidate genes. Clinical RT-qPCR supported higher CDKL5, IL6, and NHSL2 expression and lower CRIP1 and TNNI2 expression in COPD. IL6 knockdown reduced epithelial IL6 expression and attenuated several macrophage-associated transcriptional responses in co-culture after epithelial cigarette smoke extract exposure. Secretory responses varied by cell line and siRNA; co-culture IL-10 reductions were significant in the HBEC3-KT system but not in the BEAS-2B system. IL6 knockdown also reduced epithelial wound closure. The nomogram was evaluated within its development cohort and lacked independent external validation. CONCLUSION: The study identifies five COPD-associated candidate genes and provides experimental evidence linking epithelial IL6 perturbation to selected co-culture responses and wound closure. These findings do not establish a COPD-specific mechanism or therapeutic benefit. The nomogram remains exploratory and requires independent validation.

papers.abstract_en: BACKGROUND: IgG4-related lung disease (IgG4-RLD) is a fibroinflammatory pulmonary manifestation of IgG4-related disease (IgG4-RD). Its comorbidity with seropositive undifferentiated arthritis (SUA) is rare and may be overlooked due to overlapping clinical and immunological features. CASE PRESENTATION: A 71-year-old man with acute left knee pain secondary to a meniscal tear with synovitis, as confirmed by MRI, was scheduled for arthroscopy. A preoperative chest radiograph incidentally revealed diffuse right lung lesions. DIAGNOSTIC WORKUP AND THERAPEUTIC STRATEGY: Laboratory studies showed elevated rheumatoid factor (RF) and anti-cyclic citrullinated peptide (anti-CCP) antibodies. The first multidisciplinary team (MDT) discussion established a diagnosis of SUA and initiated disease-modifying antirheumatic drug (DMARD) therapy, which resolved the arthralgia but did not improve the lung lesions. A subsequent MDT review, incorporating chest CT findings (thickened bronchovascular bundles and consolidation) and lung biopsy results, confirmed the diagnosis of IgG4-RLD. Treatment was then adjusted to high-dose glucocorticoids combined with DMARDs. Both pulmonary and articular manifestations showed significant remission. CONCLUSION: This rare case of IgG4-RLD complicating SUA highlights the importance of considering IgG4-RLD in patients with seropositive inflammatory arthritis presenting with atypical pulmonary imaging findings, particularly when lung lesions fail to respond to conventional DMARD therapy. MDT collaboration is essential for accurate diagnosis and optimal management of these concomitant autoimmune conditions.

papers.abstract_en: Basophils are rare cells best known for their role in allergy but their contribution to cancer remains poorly understood. Here, we found that basophils suppress early lung metastatic seeding in mice by enhancing antitumor CD8+ T cell immunity through inhibition of regulatory T (Treg) cells. Basophils restrain Treg cells through two complementary mechanisms: mast cell protease 8-mediated cleavage of interleukin-2 receptor α and histamine-mediated activation of the histamine H1 receptor (HRH1). HRH1 blockade with loratadine abolished Treg cell suppression and accelerated metastatic seeding in mice. In a prospective double-blind crossover trial of loratadine versus placebo enrolling 40 healthy volunteers ( IRCT20170608034390N14 ), circulating Treg cell frequency (primary outcome) increased following loratadine. Higher blood basophil counts predicted improved survival across human cancers and integrative multiomic analyses identified conserved quiescent (B0) and tumor-associated (B1) basophil states, with B0 predicting favorable outcomes. These findings identify basophils as regulators of early metastatic progression and highlight the basophil-Treg cell axis as a potential therapeutic target.

papers.title_en: Discordance of PD-L1 expression between primary and paired metastatic non-small cell lung cancer: a systematic review and meta-analysis.
papers.authors: Zhang L, Gao Y, Wang X, Gu Y, Hou L, Wang X
papers.affiliation_highlight: Department of Pathology, China-Japan Union Hospital of Jilin University, Changchun, Jilin, China.
papers.authors_conclusion: In patients with NSCLC, PD-L1 expression frequently differs between primary and metastatic lesions, with a greater tendency for expression to decrease at metastatic sites. These findings indicate that PD-L1 results obtained from an archival primary tumor should be interpreted with caution when they are used to inform treatment of metastatic disease. Whether repeat testing of metastatic tissue improves patient selection or immunotherapy outcomes has not been demonstrated and requires prospective evaluation.

papers.abstract_en: BACKGROUND: PD-L1 expression in non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC) serves as a key predictive biomarker of response to immune checkpoint inhibitors; however, the concordance of PD-L1 expression between primary tumors and their corresponding metastatic lesions remains uncertain. We therefore performed a systematic review and meta-analysis to evaluate the variability of PD-L1 expression across paired primary and metastatic NSCLC sites. METHODS: We systematically searched the Cochrane Library, Embase, PubMed, and Web of Science for eligible studies. Pooled discordance rates and patterns of mismatch were estimated using a random-effects model, and subgroup analyses were conducted according to PD-L1 cutoff, antibody clone, and metastatic site. RESULTS: Fifteen studies fulfilled the inclusion criteria, encompassing 1,029 matched primary-metastatic sample pairs from 1,014 patients with NSCLC. The pooled analysis revealed an overall PD-L1 discordance rate of 21% between primary tumors and corresponding metastases (95% CI: 18%-25%). Notably, transitions from PD-L1-positive primary tumors to PD-L1-negative metastatic lesions occurred more frequently (26%, 95% CI: 22%-30%) than the reverse pattern, from negative primaries to positive metastases (18%, 95% CI: 12%-24%). Discordance of similar magnitude was observed across PD-L1 positivity thresholds and antibody clones and in both lymph node and brain metastases, although the site-specific estimates are exploratory. DISCUSSION: In patients with NSCLC, PD-L1 expression frequently differs between primary and metastatic lesions, with a greater tendency for expression to decrease at metastatic sites. These findings indicate that PD-L1 results obtained from an archival primary tumor should be interpreted with caution when they are used to inform treatment of metastatic disease. Whether repeat testing of metastatic tissue improves patient selection or immunotherapy outcomes has not been demonstrated and requires prospective evaluation. SYSTEMATIC REVIEW REGISTRATION: https://www.crd.york.ac.uk/PROSPERO, identifier CRD42022336191.

papers.abstract_en: RATIONALE: Pulse oximetry may overestimate oxygen saturation in individuals with darker skin pigmentation, potentially reducing detection of desaturation during sleep-disordered breathing. OBJECTIVES: To assess racial/ethnic differences in desaturation-based obstructive event detection and cardiovascular risk, and evaluate heart-rate response as an oximetry-independent marker for risk stratification. METHODS: We analyzed participants without cardiovascular disease in the Multi-Ethnic Study of Atherosclerosis(MESA) and Sleep Heart Health Study(SHHS). We modeled desaturation-based AHI relative to airflow-defined AHI and examined AHI-ΔHR6, defined by respiratory events with a heart-rate increase ≥6 beats/min. Adjusted Cox models evaluated associations with a composite outcome, major adverse cardiovascular events or all-cause mortality(MACE/mortality). MEASUREMENTS AND MAIN RESULTS: Black participants had 21% and 20% lower proportions of airflow-defined events meeting the ≥4% desaturation criterion than White participants in MESA (ratio 0.79[95% CI,0.68-0.93]; p = 0.003) and SHHS (0.80[0.68-0.94]; p = 0.008), respectively. No other racial/ethnic group showed a lower proportion of airflow-defined events meeting desaturation criteria than White participants. AHI-ΔHR6 event detection was similar between Black and White participants in both cohorts. In Whites participants, desaturation-based events were associated with MACE/mortality in MESA but not in SHHS, while desaturation-based AHI measures were not significantly associated with MACE/mortality in Black individuals in either cohort. In contrast, AHI-ΔHR6 was associated with MACE/mortality in MESA (HR 1.33[1.09-1.63];p=0.006) and SHHS (1.26[1.02-1.55]; p = 0.033). CONCLUSIONS: Desaturation-based scoring identified a lower proportion of reduced flow events in Black than White participants, whereas heart-rate-response-based event detection was similar across groups, suggesting oximetry-related under-detection in individuals with darker pigment.
